<style>
:root {
  --surface: #0f0f0f;
  --surface-light: #1a1a1a;
  --border: #2a2a2a;
  --text-primary: #e0e0e0;
  --text-secondary: #777;
  --highlight: #d4af37;
  --c-deep: #4a9eff;
  --c-read: #d4af37;
  --c-debate: #a855f7;
  --c-critique: #2dd4bf;
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
body { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 100vh; padding: 2rem; }

/* ═══════════════ AUDIO DOCK ═══════════════ */
.audio-dock {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 480px;
  background: var(--surface-light);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: .625rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color .3s ease;
}
.audio-dock:hover { border-color: rgba(212,175,55,.25); }

/* ── PILL ROW ── */
.dock-pills {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.dock-pill {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: .4rem;
  padding: .6rem .5rem;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .6rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: all .25s ease;
  position: relative;
}
.dock-pill::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 15%; right: 15%;
  height: 2px; border-radius: 1px;
  background: transparent;
  transition: all .25s ease;
}
.dock-pill:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: rgba(255,255,255,.03); }
.dock-pill[data-src="deep"]    { --pill-c: var(--c-deep); }
.dock-pill[data-src="read"]    { --pill-c: var(--c-read); }
.dock-pill[data-src="debate"]  { --pill-c: var(--c-debate); }
.dock-pill[data-src="critique"]{ --pill-c: var(--c-critique); }
.dock-pill.active { color: var(--pill-c); background: rgba(255,255,255,.02); }
.dock-pill.active::after { background: var(--pill-c); box-shadow: 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--pill-c) 40%, transparent); }
.dock-pill .pill-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; opacity: .5; transition: opacity .25s; }
.dock-pill.active .pill-dot { opacity: 1; }
.dock-pill.unavailable { opacity: .3; cursor: default; pointer-events: none; }

/* ── PLAYER BODY ── */
.dock-body { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; padding: .65rem .85rem; }
.dock-play {
  width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--highlight); background: transparent;
  color: var(--highlight); font-size: .7rem; cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0; transition: all .2s ease;
}
.dock-play:hover { background: rgba(212,175,55,.1); transform: scale(1.05); }
.dock-play.playing { animation: pulse-ring 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes pulse-ring {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(212,175,55,.2); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(212,175,55,.05); }
}
.dock-track-wrap { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .25rem; min-width: 0; }
.dock-track { width: 100%; height: 4px; background: #222; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
.dock-fill { height: 100%; width: 0%; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--highlight); transition: width .15s linear, background .3s; }
.dock-times { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: .5rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.dock-vol { background: none; border: none; color: var(--text-secondary); cursor: pointer; font-size: .75rem; flex-shrink: 0; padding: 2px; transition: color .2s; }
.dock-vol:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
.dock-empty { display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: .85rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: .55rem; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-secondary); opacity: .5; font-style: italic; }
.dock-body.hidden { display: none; }
.dock-empty.visible { display: flex; }
</style>

<style>
:root{
  --bg:#050505; --surface:#0a0a0a; --surface2:#111; --surface3:#1a1a1a;
  --border:#222; --border-2:#2a2a2a; --border-hi:#3a3a3a;
  --text:#e5e3df; --text-dim:#9a9a9a; --text-muted:#5a5a5a;
  --gold:#d4af37; --gold-dim:rgba(212,175,55,.1);
  --red:#c94040; --red-dim:rgba(201,64,64,.1);
  --blue:#5b9bd5; --blue-dim:rgba(91,155,213,.1);
  --teal:#3bb39a; --teal-dim:rgba(59,179,154,.1);
  --purple:#a78bfa; --purple-dim:rgba(167,139,250,.1);
  --green:#7fc77f;
  --serif:'Crimson Text',Georgia,serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
  --display:'Oswald','Inter',sans-serif;
  --sans:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --max:1180px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.55;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold);font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400}

/* Homepage uses its own header; suppress generated reader bars and subdomain rail. */
.site-shell-top,
.site-shell-subdomains,
.site-audit-footer,
.site-shell-credit,
.mtl-reader-bar{display:none !important}
body.site-shell-enabled .ph{top:0 !important}
body.site-shell-enabled .hero{padding-top:7rem !important}

/* ── Coming Soon states ── */
.rung-soon{opacity:.35;pointer-events:none;cursor:default}
.rung-soon .rung-meta{color:var(--text-muted);font-style:italic}
.as-soon{opacity:.3;pointer-events:none;cursor:default;border-color:var(--border) !important}
.as-soon h3{color:var(--text-muted) !important}
.as-soon-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--text-muted);font-style:italic}
.start-card.start-soon{opacity:.3;pointer-events:none;cursor:default}
.start-card.start-soon .start-meta{font-style:italic}
.theme-card.theme-soon{opacity:.25;pointer-events:none}
.theme-card.theme-soon h3{color:var(--text-muted)}
/* MDA highlight in theme grid */
.theme-card.theme-live{border-color:var(--red) !important;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(201,64,64,.12)}
kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7em;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid var(--border-2);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;color:var(--text-dim)}

/* ── Persistent header ── */
.ph{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:50;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:1.5rem;padding:.8rem 1.25rem;background:transparent;border-bottom:0;pointer-events:none}
.ph-scrolled,.ph-inner{background:transparent;border-bottom-color:transparent}
.ph-brand{display:none !important;align-items:center;gap:.55rem}
.ph-mark{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1}
.ph-name{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.25em;color:var(--text)}
.ph-links{display:none !important;gap:.25rem;flex:1;justify-content:center}
.ph-links a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.45rem .75rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-dim);transition:all .15s}
.ph-links a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim)}
.ph-crumb{flex:1;display:none !important;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--text-muted);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.ph-crumb a{color:var(--text-dim)}
.ph-crumb a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.ph-here{color:var(--text)}
.ph-sep{color:var(--text-muted);opacity:.6}
.ph-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;padding:.48rem .72rem;background:rgba(5,5,5,.72);border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.75rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;pointer-events:auto;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.ph-search:hover{border-color:var(--border-hi);color:var(--text);background:rgba(10,10,10,.9)}
.ph-search-text{margin-right:1rem}
@media(max-width:780px){.ph{padding:.65rem .8rem}.ph-links{display:none}.ph-search-text{display:inline;margin-right:.55rem}}

/* ── Hero ── */
.hero{position:relative;padding:7rem 1.5rem 4rem;text-align:center;overflow:hidden}
.hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:30%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:900px;height:600px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(212,175,55,.05) 0%,transparent 65%);pointer-events:none}
.hero-inner{max-width:880px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}
.hero-tag{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.hero-h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6.5vw,4.6rem);line-height:1.05;color:#fff;margin-bottom:1.1rem;text-wrap:balance;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hero-h1-grand{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:300;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.hero-h1-grand em{font-family:var(--serif);text-transform:none;font-weight:400;font-style:italic}
.hero-sub{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--text-dim);max-width:620px;margin:0 auto 1.4rem;text-wrap:pretty}
.hero-eq{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:.95rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.55;margin-bottom:2rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
.hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:2.2rem}
.btn{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:500;padding:.7rem 1.1rem;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.45rem;transition:all .15s;text-decoration:none}
.btn-primary{background:var(--gold);color:#0a0a0a;border-color:var(--gold)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:#e0bd49;border-color:#e0bd49;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--text);border-color:var(--border-2)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--border-hi);background:var(--surface)}
.hero-meta{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--text-muted);display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero-meta b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500}
.hero-meta .dot{opacity:.4}
.claim-atlas-card{max-width:880px;margin:1.65rem auto 1.45rem;text-align:left;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(212,175,55,.25),rgba(212,175,55,.11) 52%,rgba(201,64,64,.06)),var(--surface2);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.44);border-radius:10px;padding:1.45rem 1.55rem;box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.34),0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,.08);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.claim-atlas-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent)}
.claim-atlas-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:.55rem}
.claim-atlas-card p{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.06rem,2vw,1.28rem);line-height:1.55;color:var(--text);max-width:68ch}
.claim-atlas-card strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.claim-atlas-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.55rem;margin-top:1rem}
.claim-atlas-actions a{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.25);border-radius:5px;padding:.5rem .65rem;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);transition:all .15s}
.claim-atlas-actions a:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);color:#fff}
.hero-intro-card{margin-top:1.8rem}
.hero-intro-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero-intro-audio{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.28);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.24);color:var(--gold);padding:.5rem .82rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.hero-intro-audio:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);color:#fff}
.hero-intro-audio.is-pinned{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:#0a0a0a}
.hero-intro-audio i{font-size:.78rem}
.hero-intro-card p{font-size:clamp(1.12rem,2.05vw,1.38rem);line-height:1.62}
.hero-intro-card.is-previewing{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.68);box-shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.42),0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
.hero-intro-note{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.65rem;align-items:center;margin-top:1rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.hero-intro-note b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}

/* ── Sections ── */
.sec{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:4rem 1.5rem 2rem}
.sh{margin-bottom:1.8rem}
.sh-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.sh-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}
.sh-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.15em}
.sh h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.1rem);font-weight:400;color:#fff}
.sh-desc{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--text-dim);max-width:680px;text-wrap:pretty}

/* ── Start Here ── */
.start-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:1rem}

.start-card h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.35rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.5rem;line-height:1.25}
.start-card p{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--text-dim);flex:1;text-wrap:pretty}
.start-meta{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:1rem;padding-top:.7rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}

.proof-callout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(280px,.8fr);gap:1rem;align-items:stretch;margin:1.15rem 0 1.4rem}

.proof-callout-main p,.proof-callout-side p{font-size:1.02rem;line-height:1.72;color:var(--text-dim);text-wrap:pretty}
.proof-quicklinks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:.7rem;margin:1rem 0 1.2rem}
.proof-link-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.35rem;padding:1rem 1.05rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;transition:all .15s}
.proof-link-card:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:rgba(91,155,213,.45);background:rgba(91,155,213,.07)}
.proof-link-card strong{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff}
.proof-link-card span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
.proof-link-card em{font-family:var(--sans);font-style:normal;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--text-dim)}
.proof-pill-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem}
.proof-pill-row .btn{font-size:.92rem;padding:.8rem 1.15rem}
.proof-callout-side ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem;margin-top:.9rem}
.proof-callout-side li{font-size:.96rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text-dim);padding-left:.95rem;position:relative}
.proof-callout-side li::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:.62rem;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);opacity:.9}
@media(max-width:900px){.proof-callout{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* One-pager rail */
.one-pager-band{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(212,175,55,.08) 0%,rgba(212,175,55,.02) 100%),var(--surface2);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2);border-radius:10px;padding:2rem 2rem 1.5rem;margin-bottom:2rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.one-pager-band::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-1px;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent)}
.one-pager-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1rem}
.one-pager-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:.6rem}
.one-pager-band h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,2.8rem);color:#fff;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.one-pager-desc{font-size:1rem;color:var(--text-dim);max-width:760px;line-height:1.7}
.one-pager-summary{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.67rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:.9rem}
.one-pager-summary b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500}
.one-pager-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.one-pager-nav{display:flex;gap:.45rem}
.one-pager-arrow{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.22);background:rgba(10,10,10,.8);color:var(--gold);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.one-pager-arrow:hover{background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.one-pager-arrow:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none}
.one-pager-count{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase;min-width:84px;text-align:center}
.one-pager-window{position:relative}
.one-pager-window::before,.one-pager-window::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;bottom:.65rem;width:48px;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;transition:opacity .15s}
.one-pager-window::before{left:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(17,17,17,.98),rgba(17,17,17,0))}
.one-pager-window::after{right:0;background:linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(17,17,17,.98),rgba(17,17,17,0))}
.one-pager-window.at-start::before{opacity:0}
.one-pager-window.at-end::after{opacity:0}
.one-pager-strip{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:minmax(320px,1fr);gap:1rem;overflow-x:auto;padding:.1rem 0 .9rem;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--border-hi) var(--surface2)}
.one-pager-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{height:8px}
.one-pager-strip::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);border-radius:999px}
.one-pager-strip::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(212,175,55,.26);border-radius:999px}
.one-pager-card{scroll-snap-align:start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:248px;background:rgba(6,6,6,.9);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:1.3rem 1.25rem 1.1rem;transition:all .18s;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.01)}
.one-pager-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(212,175,55,.06);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.one-pager-card-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem;margin-bottom:.9rem}
.one-pager-code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.14em}
.one-pager-hint{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.one-pager-card h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.7rem;color:#fff;line-height:1.08;margin-bottom:.55rem}
.one-pager-card p{font-size:1rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.65;flex:1}
.one-pager-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;align-items:center;margin-top:1rem;padding-top:.85rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase}
.one-pager-meta strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .one-pager-band{padding:1.5rem 1.2rem 1.1rem}
  .one-pager-band h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,8vw,2.2rem)}
  .one-pager-desc{font-size:.92rem}
  .one-pager-strip{grid-auto-columns:minmax(280px,88vw)}
  .one-pager-card{min-height:220px}
  .one-pager-window::before,.one-pager-window::after{width:24px}
}

/* Duality feature */
.duality-feature{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(280px,.85fr);gap:1rem;align-items:stretch;margin:0 0 2rem}
.duality-main,.duality-side{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(167,139,250,.09),rgba(167,139,250,.03) 55%,var(--surface));border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.22);border-radius:10px;padding:1.45rem 1.5rem}
.duality-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--purple);margin-bottom:.55rem}
.duality-main h3,.duality-side h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.8vw,2.1rem);font-weight:400;line-height:1.1;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.65rem}
.duality-main p,.duality-side p{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--text-dim);text-wrap:pretty}
.duality-points{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:.65rem;margin:1rem 0 1.1rem}
.duality-point{padding:.85rem .9rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px}
.duality-point strong{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.02rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.2rem}
.duality-point span{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.55}
.duality-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.65rem;margin-top:1rem}
.duality-side ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.65rem;margin-top:.85rem}
.duality-side li{font-size:.94rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text-dim);padding-left:.95rem;position:relative}
.duality-side li::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:.62rem;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--purple)}
@media(max-width:900px){.duality-feature{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ── Reading Ladder (the big one) ── */
.sec-ladder{padding-top:3rem}
.ladder-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;margin-top:1.5rem}
@media(max-width:900px){.ladder-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rung{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--surface2),var(--surface));border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.rung-1{border-top:3px solid var(--green)}
.rung-2{border-top:3px solid var(--gold)}
.rung-3{border-top:3px solid var(--blue)}
.rung-head{padding:1.4rem 1.4rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);position:relative}
.rung-tier{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--text-muted)}
.rung-glyph{position:absolute;top:1rem;right:1.4rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.15em;opacity:.6}
.rung-1 .rung-glyph{color:var(--green)}
.rung-2 .rung-glyph{color:var(--gold)}
.rung-3 .rung-glyph{color:var(--blue)}
.rung-head h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.9rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin:.35rem 0 .45rem}
.rung-head p{font-size:.94rem;line-height:1.65;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:.75rem;max-width:28ch}
.rung-count{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em}
.rung-list{list-style:none;padding:.5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.15rem;flex:1}
.rung-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:.7rem;align-items:center;padding:.55rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text);transition:all .12s}
.rung-item:hover{background:var(--surface3)}
.rung-code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);min-width:48px}
.rung-title{color:var(--text);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.rung-meta{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);text-align:right}
.rung-item.rung-gold:hover .rung-code{color:var(--gold)}
.rung-item.rung-red:hover .rung-code{color:var(--red)}
.rung-item.rung-teal:hover .rung-code{color:var(--teal)}
.rung-item.rung-blue:hover .rung-code{color:var(--blue)}
.rung-item.rung-purple:hover .rung-code{color:var(--purple)}
.rung-more{display:block;padding:.6rem .7rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--gold);border-top:1px dashed var(--border);margin-top:.4rem}
.rung-more:hover{background:var(--gold-dim)}

/* ── Reading Order ── */
.order-timeline{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;padding-left:2rem;border-left:1px dashed var(--border-2);margin-left:1rem}
.to-item{padding:.6rem 0}
.to-link{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:1rem;color:var(--text);position:relative;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;transition:background .15s}
.to-link:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
.to-act{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--gold);min-width:5rem}
.to-dot{position:absolute;left:-2.42rem;top:.85rem;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--bg)}
.to-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:#fff;flex:1}
.to-soon{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.to-item.soon{opacity:.45}
.to-item.soon .to-dot{background:var(--text-muted)}

.order-grid{list-style:none;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:.5rem}
.og-item a{display:flex;gap:.8rem;padding:.7rem .85rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;background:var(--surface2);transition:all .15s}
.og-item a:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.og-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;line-height:1;font-weight:500}
.og-act{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:.15rem}
.og-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:.95rem;color:#fff;line-height:1.25}
.og-title em{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.7em;font-style:italic}
.og-item.soon{opacity:.4}

/* ── Master Narrative inline story ── */
.master-story-deck{display:grid;gap:.75rem}
.master-act{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--surface2),var(--surface));border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}
.master-act[open]{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.35);box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.24)}
.master-act summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer}
.master-act summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.master-act .to-link{padding:1rem 1.1rem;align-items:center}
.master-act .to-dot{left:-2.42rem;top:1.45rem}
.master-act .to-title{font-size:1.18rem}
.to-status{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);white-space:nowrap}
.master-act[open] .to-status{color:var(--gold)}
.master-panel{padding:0 1.35rem 1.35rem 7.2rem}
.act-player{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:.45rem;margin-bottom:1.1rem;padding:.8rem;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px}
.act-player-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted)}
.act-player audio{width:100%;height:34px}
.audio-pending{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.45rem 0}
.act-copy{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.08rem,1.9vw,1.28rem);line-height:1.72;color:var(--text-dim)}
.act-copy p{margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.story-link{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;font-style:italic;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(212,175,55,.45);transition:all .15s}
.story-link:hover{color:#f0c659;border-bottom-color:#f0c659;text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(212,175,55,.18)}
.story-link.visited{color:var(--text-muted);border-bottom-color:transparent}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .order-timeline{padding-left:1.2rem;margin-left:.4rem}
  .master-panel{padding:0 1rem 1rem 1rem}
  .master-act .to-link{gap:.65rem;align-items:flex-start}
  .master-act .to-title{font-size:1rem}
  .to-status{display:none}
}

/* ── Themes ── */
.theme-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:.85rem}
.theme-card{padding:1.1rem 1.2rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;transition:border-color .2s}
.theme-card:hover{border-color:var(--border-hi)}
.theme-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.theme-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%}
.theme-card h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;flex:1}
.theme-n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted)}
.theme-desc{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:.7rem;text-wrap:pretty}
.theme-card ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.1rem;font-size:.78rem}
.theme-card li a{display:block;padding:.3rem .4rem;border-radius:3px;color:var(--text-dim);transition:all .12s;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.theme-card li a:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--surface3)}
.theme-card li a span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-right:.4rem}
.theme-more{padding:.3rem .4rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted)}

/* ── All Series filters + grid ── */
.filters{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1.2rem;padding:.55rem;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px}
.filter-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.35rem .6rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;flex:1;min-width:180px}
.filter-search span{color:var(--text-muted)}
.filter-search input{flex:1;background:transparent;border:0;outline:0;color:var(--text);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.82rem}
.filter-search button{background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem}
.filter-tier{display:flex;gap:.15rem;background:var(--surface2);padding:.2rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px}
.filter-tier button{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.72rem;padding:.35rem .65rem;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--text-dim);border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer}
.filter-tier button.on{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--text)}
.filter-cluster{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.78rem;padding:.45rem .55rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;color:var(--text);outline:0;cursor:pointer}
.filter-count{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-left:auto;padding:0 .5rem}

.all-grid{display:grid;gap:.7rem}
.all-grid-comfortable{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr))}
.all-grid-compact{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr))}
.as-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:.95rem 1rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:2px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;transition:all .15s;min-height:120px;position:relative}
.as-card:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:var(--surface3);border-color:var(--border-hi)}
.as-gold{border-left-color:var(--gold)} .as-gold:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
.as-red{border-left-color:var(--red)} .as-red:hover{border-color:var(--red)}
.as-teal{border-left-color:var(--teal)} .as-teal:hover{border-color:var(--teal)}
.as-blue{border-left-color:var(--blue)} .as-blue:hover{border-color:var(--blue)}
.as-purple{border-left-color:var(--purple)} .as-purple:hover{border-color:var(--purple)}
.as-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.1em}
.as-code{color:var(--text-dim)}
.as-tier{color:var(--text-muted);padding:.05rem .35rem;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:2px}
.as-feat{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);padding:.05rem .35rem;border-radius:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
.as-ext{margin-left:auto;color:var(--text-muted)}
.as-card h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.as-card p{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-dim);flex:1;text-wrap:pretty}
.as-foot{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:.6rem}
.all-empty{padding:3rem;text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);font-style:italic;grid-column:1/-1}

/* ── Footer ── */
footer{max-width:var(--max);margin:3rem auto 0;padding:3rem 1.5rem;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
footer .feq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.7rem}
footer p{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.78rem;margin:.3rem 0}
footer .vow{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:1rem}

/* ── Command palette ── */
.cp-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding-top:12vh;animation:cp-fade .15s ease}
@keyframes cp-fade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.cp-modal{width:min(620px,92vw);background:#0e0e0e;border:1px solid var(--border-hi);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-height:70vh}
.cp-input-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;padding:.85rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.cp-search-icon{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:1.1rem}
.cp-input{flex:1;background:transparent;border:0;outline:0;color:#fff;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:1rem}
.cp-esc{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);border:1px solid var(--border-2);padding:.15rem .35rem;border-radius:3px}
.cp-results{overflow-y:auto;flex:1;padding:.4rem}
.cp-empty{padding:2rem 1rem;text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.85rem;font-style:italic}
.cp-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;padding:.55rem .7rem;border-radius:5px;color:var(--text);transition:background .1s}
.cp-row.sel{background:var(--surface3)}
.cp-row:hover{background:var(--surface3)}
.cp-badge{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;font-weight:500;padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.05em;flex-shrink:0;min-width:34px;text-align:center}
.cp-row-text{flex:1;min-width:0}
.cp-row-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:.95rem;color:#fff;line-height:1.2;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.cp-row-sub{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:.15rem}
.cp-arrow{color:var(--text-muted);opacity:0;transition:opacity .1s}
.cp-row.sel .cp-arrow{opacity:1}
.cp-foot{display:flex;gap:1rem;padding:.55rem .9rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted)}
.cp-foot kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border-2);padding:.05rem .3rem;border-radius:2px;color:var(--text-dim);margin-right:.2rem}

/* ── Master Story feature (the essential read) ── */
.ms-feature{max-width:var(--max);margin:3rem auto 1rem;padding:0 1.5rem;position:relative}
.ms-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:2rem;align-items:stretch;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(212,175,55,.08) 0%,rgba(201,64,64,.04) 100%),var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--gold-dim);border-radius:10px;padding:2.2rem 2rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ms-inner::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-1px;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent)}

  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--f-mono);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.2em 0.6em;
  border-radius: 2px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.tag-hold  { background: rgba(154,124,58,0.15); color: var(--gold); }
.tag-leak  { background: rgba(122,32,32,0.1);  color: var(--red-claim); }
.tag-open  { background: rgba(30,80,40,0.1);   color: #2a5c30; }

/* ── VERDICT ── */
.verdict {
  margin: 3rem 0;
  padding: 2.5rem;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.verdict::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    -45deg,
    transparent,
    transparent 40px,
    rgba(154,124,58,0.03) 40px,
    rgba(154,124,58,0.03) 41px
  );
}

.verdict-inner { position: relative; }

.verdict-label {
  font-family: var(--f-mono);
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.25em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold-soft);
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}

.verdict-statement {
  font-family: var(--f-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.4rem);
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--paper);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.verdict-statement em {
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--gold-soft);
}

.verdict-body {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: rgba(247,244,239,0.7);
  max-width: 560px;
}

/* ── STRUCTURE CHAIN ── */
.chain {
  margin: 2.5rem 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
}

.chain-step {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--rule);
  position: relative;
}

.chain-step:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }

.chain-num {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem 0;
  font-family: var(--f-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-ghost);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
}

.chain-content {
  padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft);
}

.chain-title {
  font-family: var(--f-display);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

.chain-desc {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.chain-step.active .chain-num {
  color: var(--gold);
  border-right-color: var(--gold);
}

.chain-step.active {
  border-left-color: var(--gold);
}

.chain-step.active .chain-title { color: var(--gold); }

/* ── TEMPLETON NOTE ── */
.templeton-note {
  margin: 3rem 0;
  padding: 2rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  background: var(--paper-warm);
  position: relative;
}

.templeton-note::before {
  content: 'A NOTE TO THE FOUNDATION';
  position: absolute;
  top: -0.55rem;
  left: 1.5rem;
  background: var(--paper-warm);
  padding: 0 0.5rem;
  font-family: var(--f-mono);
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--gold);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.templeton-note p {
  font-family: var(--f-display);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

.templeton-note p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

/* ── PROOF CORPUS ── */
.corpus-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: 1px;
  background: var(--rule);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  margin: 1.5rem 0;
}

.corpus-item {
  background: var(--paper);
  padding: 1.1rem 1.3rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: block;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}

.corpus-item:hover { background: var(--gold-trace); }

.corpus-tag {
  font-family: var(--f-mono);
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-ghost);
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.corpus-title {
  font-family: var(--f-display);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.corpus-desc {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  margin-top: 0.3rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ── FOOTER ── */
.footer {
  border-top: 2px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 2rem;
  margin-top: 4rem;
  max-width: 860px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.footer-left {
  font-family: var(--f-mono);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--text-ghost);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.footer-right {
  font-family: var(--f-display);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

/* ── UTILITIES ── */
.divider {
  border: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-soft);
  margin: 1.5rem 0;
}

.spacer { height: 2rem; }

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .masthead, .container { padding-left: 1.2rem; padding-right: 1.2rem; }
  .split-bar { flex-direction: column; }
  .claims-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .footer { flex-direction: column; }
}

</style>

<style>

<style>
:root {
  --bg:#050505; --surface:#0a0a0a; --surface2:#111; --surface3:#1a1a1a;

/* ═══════ TOP BAR ═══════ */
.tp-top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);height:var(--header-h)}

@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}

.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}

.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}

.tp-sub-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,rgba(212,175,55,.1),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s}

.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}

/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */
.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}
.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-series-strip a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-series-strip a.soon{opacity:.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}
.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}

/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */
.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}
.tp-bottom-eq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.6rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
.tp-bottom-copy{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.68rem;margin:.25rem 0}
.tp-bottom-vow{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.82rem;margin-top:.8rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem}

.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-gold 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse-gold{0%,100%{opacity:.6}50%{opacity:1}}
.tp-door-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:.5rem;cursor:default;transition:all .5s;position:relative}
.tp-door-num:hover{text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--gold-glow),0 0 60px rgba(212,175,55,.2);letter-spacing:.22em}
.tp-door-sub{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .3s;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.5}
.tp-door:hover .tp-door-sub{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-door-mark{display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:1.2rem auto 0;opacity:.4}

/* ═══════ SCROLLBAR ═══════ */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border-2);border-radius:3px}

/* ═══════ SELECTION ═══════ */

</style>

/* ── HERO ── */
.hero{padding:6rem 0 3rem;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}

/* ── AUDIO ── */
.audio-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;max-width:1000px;margin:2rem auto 0}
.audio-bar .atag{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-l);white-space:nowrap}

/* ── SECTION DIVIDER ── */
.sec-div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;margin:3rem 0 1.5rem}
.sec-div .tag{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.5rem;letter-spacing:.35em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-l);white-space:nowrap}
.sec-div::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--border-h),transparent)}

/* ── RESOURCE STRIP ── */
.res-strip{display:flex;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin:2rem 0}
.res-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.5rem 1rem;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text-d);text-decoration:none;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.05em;transition:all .2s}

  text-decoration:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.4rem;

.paper-card:hover{background:var(--surface2)}

.paper-card.highlight:hover{background:rgba(59,130,246,0.12)}
.paper-card.highlight .pc-tag{color:var(--accent-l)}

.paper-card.full{grid-column:1/-1}

/* ── ABOUT BOX ── */
.about{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2rem;margin:2rem 0}
.about .atitle{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.5rem;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-l);margin-bottom:.8rem}
.about p{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-d);line-height:1.85;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.about p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

/* ── FOOTER ── */
.foot{text-align:center;padding:2.5rem;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-m);letter-spacing:.1em;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:2rem}

@media(max-width:700px){
  .paper-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .paper-card.full{grid-column:auto}
  .res-strip{flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
}

<style>
:root {
  --bg:#050505; --surface:#0a0a0a; --surface2:#111; --surface3:#1a1a1a;
  --border:#222; --border-2:#2a2a2a; --border-hi:#3a3a3a;
  --text:#e5e3df; --text-dim:#9a9a9a; --text-muted:#5a5a5a;
  --gold:#d4af37; --gold-dim:rgba(212,175,55,.08); --gold-glow:rgba(212,175,55,.3);
  --red:#c94040; --teal:#3bb39a; --blue:#7cc7ff; --purple:#a78bfa; --green:#7fc77f;
  --serif:'Crimson Text',Georgia,serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
  --display:'Oswald','Inter',sans-serif;
  --sans:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --max:1140px; --header-h:48px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

/* ═══════ TOP BAR ═══════ */
.tp-top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);height:var(--header-h)}
.tp-top-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;height:100%;padding:0 1.2rem;gap:.6rem}
.tp-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:.2rem .4rem .2rem 0;border-radius:4px;transition:background .3s}
.tp-brand-chi{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1;transition:all .3s}
.tp-brand-name{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .3s}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-chi{text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-name{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-brand::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-glow),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .4s ease}
.tp-brand:hover::after{width:140px;height:140px;opacity:1}
.tp-div{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border-2);flex-shrink:0;margin:0 .3rem}

/* Left nav */
.tp-nav-links{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center}
.tp-nav-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.32rem .55rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-nav-link:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-nav-link.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.08)}
.tp-nav-link i{margin-right:.3rem;font-size:.55rem}
.tp-nav-link::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.15),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .3s}
.tp-nav-link:hover::after{width:60px;height:60px;opacity:1}
.tp-spacer{flex:1}

/* Reading levels */
.tp-levels{display:flex;gap:2px;background:var(--surface2);padding:3px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-level{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-level:hover{color:var(--text)}
.tp-level.active{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.15);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
.tp-level::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.2),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .35s}
.tp-level:hover::after{width:80px;height:80px;opacity:1}
.tp-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.35rem .6rem;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.7rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.tp-search:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-search kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:2px}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}

/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR ═══════ */
.tp-class{position:fixed;top:var(--header-h);left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.4rem 0}
.tp-class-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}
.tp-class-center{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem}
.tp-class-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-class-bar{display:flex;height:5px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;gap:1px}
.tp-class-seg{transition:flex .4s ease;position:relative}
.tp-class-seg::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-class-bar:hover .tp-class-seg::after{opacity:1}
.tp-class-tags{display:flex;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tp-class-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s}
.tp-class-tag:hover{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-class-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 4px currentColor}
/* Small nav */
.tp-class-nav{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.25rem .5rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-class-nav:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15)}
@media(max-width:600px){.tp-class-tags{display:none}}

/* ═══════ ARTICLE BODY ═══════ */
.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:calc(var(--header-h) + 68px) 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-article h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.6rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tp-article .subtitle{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.2rem;line-height:1.4}
.tp-article .byline{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:2.5rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-article h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;margin:3rem 0 1rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tp-article h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;margin:2rem 0 .6rem}
.tp-article p{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.3rem;line-height:1.75}
.tp-article blockquote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem}
.tp-article ul,.tp-article ol{margin:1rem 0 1.5rem 1.5rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.7}
.tp-article li{margin-bottom:.4rem}
.tp-article code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85rem;background:var(--surface2);padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:3px;color:var(--gold)}
.tp-article pre{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:1rem;overflow-x:auto;margin:1.5rem 0}
.tp-article pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-dim)}

/* ═══════ BIG PREV / NEXT NAV ═══════ */
.tp-bignav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-bignav-row{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:1rem}
.tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;transition:all .3s;min-height:90px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-bignav-prev{justify-content:flex-start}
.tp-bignav-next{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}
.tp-bignav-prev::before,.tp-bignav-next::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--hover-x,50%) var(--hover-y,50%),rgba(212,175,55,.06),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover::before,.tp-bignav-next:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover,.tp-bignav-next:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-bignav-arrow{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .3s;flex-shrink:0}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-arrow,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-arrow{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.1)}
.tp-bignav-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem}
.tp-bignav-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-bignav-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;transition:color .2s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-title,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-title{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-bignav-prev .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-right:1.2rem}
.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:1.2rem}

/* Center: Series Home + Site Home */
.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:140px}
.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;transition:all .25s;text-align:center;background:var(--surface2)}

.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em}

@media(max-width:650px){

.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}
.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:60%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.4}

<style>
:root {
  --bg:#050505; --surface:#0a0a0a; --surface2:#111; --surface3:#1a1a1a;

/* ═══════ TOP BAR ═══════ */
.tp-top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);height:var(--header-h)}

@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}

.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}

.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}

<style>

<style>

  --display:'Oswald','Inter',sans-serif;

  --sans:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;

  --max:1140px; --header-h:56px;

}

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}

html{scroll-behavior:smooth}

body{font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}

a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}



/* ═══════ TOP BAR ═══════ */

.tp-top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border:1px solid rgba(20,184,166,.55);border-bottom:0;height:var(--header-h)}

.tp-top-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;height:100%;padding:0 1.2rem;gap:.6rem}

.tp-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:.2rem .4rem .2rem 0;border-radius:4px;transition:background .3s}

.tp-brand-chi{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1;transition:all .3s}

.tp-brand-name{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .3s}

.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-chi{text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--gold-glow)}

.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-name{color:var(--gold)}

.tp-brand::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-glow),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .4s ease}

.tp-brand:hover::after{width:140px;height:140px;opacity:1}

.tp-div{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border-2);flex-shrink:0;margin:0 .3rem}



/* Left nav */

.tp-nav-links{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center}

.tp-nav-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.32rem .55rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid transparent}

.tp-nav-link:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(20,184,166,.15);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(20,184,166,.1)}

.tp-nav-link.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(20,184,166,.2);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(20,184,166,.08)}

.tp-nav-link i{margin-right:.3rem;font-size:.55rem}

.tp-nav-link::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(20,184,166,.15),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .3s}

.tp-nav-link:hover::after{width:60px;height:60px;opacity:1}

.tp-spacer{flex:1}



/* Reading levels */

.tp-levels{display:flex;gap:2px;background:var(--surface2);padding:3px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}

.tp-level{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.tp-level:hover{color:var(--text)}

.tp-level.active{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(20,184,166,.15);border:1px solid rgba(20,184,166,.2)}

.tp-level::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(20,184,166,.2),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .35s}

.tp-level:hover::after{width:80px;height:80px;opacity:1}

.tp-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.35rem .6rem;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.7rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}

.tp-search:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(20,184,166,.12)}

.tp-search kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:2px}

@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}



/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR (inside header lip) ═══════ */

.tp-class{position:fixed;top:var(--header-h);left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.4rem 0}

.tp-class-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}

.tp-class-center{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem}

.tp-class-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}

.tp-class-bar{display:flex;height:5px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;gap:1px}

.tp-class-seg{transition:flex .4s ease;position:relative}

.tp-class-seg::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}

.tp-class-bar:hover .tp-class-seg::after{opacity:1}

.tp-class-tags{display:flex;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap}

.tp-class-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s}

.tp-class-tag:hover{color:var(--text-dim)}

.tp-class-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 4px currentColor}

.tp-canon-meta{display:flex;gap:.35rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}

.tp-canon-chip{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;line-height:1;padding:.22rem .48rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(20,184,166,.18);color:var(--text-muted);background:rgba(20,184,166,.055);max-width:18rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}

.tp-canon-chip strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}

.tp-canon-chip.summary{flex:1 1 18rem;color:var(--text-dim);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}

.tp-class-nav{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.25rem .5rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent}

.tp-class-nav:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(20,184,166,.15)}

@media(max-width:600px){.tp-class-tags,.tp-canon-meta{display:none}}



/* ═══════ VERIFIED BAR PINNED UNDER TOP BAR — full-bleed, sticky ═══════ */

.verification-bar.tp-verify-top{

  position:sticky;top:var(--header-h);z-index:90;

  left:auto;right:auto;width:100%;

  margin:var(--header-h) 0 0;

  background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);

  border:1px solid rgba(20,184,166,.55);border-top:0;

}

.verification-bar.tp-verify-top .verification-toggle,

.verification-bar.tp-verify-top .verification-body{

  max-width:none;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;

}

.verification-bar.tp-verify-top .verification-toggle{padding:7px 1.2rem;background:transparent}

.verification-bar.tp-verify-top .verification-toggle:hover{background:rgba(20,184,166,.04)}

.verification-bar.tp-verify-top .verification-toggle.open{border-bottom-color:rgba(20,184,166,.25)}

.v-domain-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.3rem;margin-left:auto;margin-right:.9rem}

.v-chip{

  padding:.18rem .55rem;border-radius:999px;

  font-family:var(--mono,monospace);font-size:.58rem;font-weight:600;

  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap;

  border:1px solid var(--border,#222);background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted,#5a5a5a);

}

.v-chip.on{border-color:var(--chip-color,#222);color:var(--chip-color,#5a5a5a);background:transparent;opacity:.5}

@media(max-width:700px){.v-domain-chips{display:none}}



/* ═══════ ARTICLE BODY ═══════ */

.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem}

.tp-article h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.6rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em}

.tp-article .subtitle{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.2rem;line-height:1.4}

.tp-article .byline{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:2.5rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}

.tp-article h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;margin:3rem 0 1rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:-.01em}

.tp-article h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;margin:2rem 0 .6rem}

.tp-article p{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.3rem;line-height:1.75}

.tp-article blockquote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem}

.tp-article ul,.tp-article ol{margin:1rem 0 1.5rem 1.5rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.7}

.tp-article li{margin-bottom:.4rem}

.tp-article code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85rem;background:var(--surface2);padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:3px;color:var(--gold)}

.tp-article pre{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:1rem;overflow-x:auto;margin:1.5rem 0}

.tp-article pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-dim)}

/* empty-body placeholder (template only — delete when filling in) */

.tp-template-placeholder{min-height:40vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px dashed var(--border-2);border-radius:10px;color:var(--text-muted);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:1rem}



/* ═══════ BIG PREV / NEXT NAV ═══════ */

.tp-bignav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:.4rem 1.5rem 2.5rem}

.tp-bignav-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem}

.tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:.55rem .5rem;background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;transition:all .3s;min-height:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.tp-bignav-prev{justify-content:flex-start}

.tp-bignav-next{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}

.tp-bignav-prev::before,.tp-bignav-next::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--hover-x,50%) var(--hover-y,50%),rgba(20,184,166,.08),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}

.tp-bignav-prev:hover::before,.tp-bignav-next:hover::before{opacity:1}

.tp-bignav-prev:hover,.tp-bignav-next:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}

.tp-bignav-arrow{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .3s;flex-shrink:0}

.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-arrow,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-arrow{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.15)}

.tp-bignav-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.1rem}

.tp-bignav-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}

.tp-bignav-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:.92rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.25;transition:color .2s}

.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-title,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-title{color:var(--gold)}

.tp-bignav-prev .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-right:.7rem}

.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:.7rem}



/* Center: Series Home (no box) + Site Home (the prominent box) */

.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.35rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:170px}

.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.2rem .4rem;border:0;background:transparent;transition:all .25s;text-align:center}

.tp-bignav-series:hover{color:var(--gold)}

.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.7rem 1.4rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;background:var(--surface2);transition:all .25s;margin-top:.3rem;text-align:center}

.tp-bignav-home:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(20,184,166,.14);background:var(--surface)}



@media(max-width:650px){

  .tp-bignav-row{flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}

  .tp-bignav-center{flex-direction:row;gap:1rem;padding:.6rem 0;order:-1;justify-content:center}

  .tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{padding:1.2rem 1rem}

  .tp-bignav-title{font-size:1rem}

}



/* ═══════ FINAL AUDIT ═══════ */

.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}

.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.tp-audit-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:60%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.4}

.tp-audit-head{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem}

.tp-audit-intro{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 auto .8rem;max-width:640px;line-height:1.6}

.tp-audit-covenant{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0 auto 2rem;max-width:640px;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;border-left:2px solid rgba(20,184,166,.3);border-right:2px solid rgba(20,184,166,.3);background:rgba(20,184,166,.04);line-height:1.6;font-style:italic}

.tp-audit-covenant b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;font-style:normal}

.tp-audit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;text-align:left}

@media(max-width:700px){.tp-audit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.tp-audit-col{padding:1.2rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.tp-audit-col::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(255,255,255,.03),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}

.tp-audit-col:hover::before{opacity:1}

.tp-audit-col:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}

.tp-audit-col h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.8rem}

.tp-audit-col ul{list-style:none;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.55}

.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}

.tp-audit-col li:last-child{border-bottom:0}

.tp-col-right{border-color:rgba(59,179,154,.2)}.tp-col-right h4{color:var(--teal)}

.tp-col-right:hover{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(59,179,154,.1)}

.tp-col-over{border-color:rgba(20,184,166,.2)}.tp-col-over h4{color:var(--gold)}

.tp-col-over:hover{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(20,184,166,.1)}

.tp-col-wrong{border-color:rgba(201,64,64,.2)}.tp-col-wrong h4{color:var(--red)}

.tp-col-wrong:hover{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(201,64,64,.1)}



/* ═══════ GOLD DIVIDER ═══════ */

.tp-teal-divider{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}

.tp-teal-divider-line{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(20,184,166,.3),transparent)}



/* ═══════ SUBDOMAIN GRID ═══════ */

.tp-subdomains{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:1.3rem 1.5rem}

.tp-sub-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:.35rem}

.tp-sub-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(20,184,166,.3)}

.tp-sub-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}

.tp-sub-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.7rem}

.tp-sub-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:.55rem}

@media(max-width:900px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}

@media(max-width:550px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

.tp-sub-card{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:.55rem;padding:.75rem .8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;transition:all .35s;text-align:left;min-height:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}

.tp-sub-card i{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .35s;flex-shrink:0}

.tp-sub-card h4{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);margin:0;line-height:1.2;transition:color .3s}

.tp-sub-card p{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.5rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0;line-height:1.25;transition:color .3s}

.tp-sub-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,rgba(20,184,166,.1),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s}

.tp-sub-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(20,184,166,.12)}

.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}

.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}

.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}

.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}



/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */

.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}

.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}

.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}

.tp-series-strip a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(20,184,166,.15);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(20,184,166,.1)}

.tp-series-strip a.soon{opacity:.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}

.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(20,184,166,.2)}



/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */

.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}

.tp-bottom-eq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.6rem;letter-spacing:.05em}

.tp-bottom-copy{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.68rem;margin:.25rem 0}

.tp-bottom-vow{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.82rem;margin-top:.8rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem}



/* ═══════ 15 + 15 = 100 (THE DOOR) ═══════ */

.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}

.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(20,184,166,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-teal 4s ease-in-out infinite}

@keyframes pulse-teal{0%,100%{opacity:.6}50%{opacity:1}}

.tp-door-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:.5rem;cursor:default;transition:all .5s;position:relative}

.tp-door-num:hover{text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--gold-glow),0 0 60px rgba(20,184,166,.2);letter-spacing:.22em}

.tp-door-sub{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .3s;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.5}

.tp-door:hover .tp-door-sub{color:var(--text-dim)}

.tp-door-mark{display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:1.2rem auto 0;opacity:.4}



/* ═══════ SCROLLBAR ═══════ */

::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border-2);border-radius:3px}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--border-hi)}



/* ═══════ SELECTION ═══════ */

::selection{background:rgba(20,184,166,.2);color:var(--text)}

</style>
