:root {
  --bg:#050505; --surface:#0a0a0a; --surface2:#111; --surface3:#1a1a1a;
  --border:#222; --border-2:#2a2a2a; --border-hi:#3a3a3a;
  --text:#e5e3df; --text-dim:#9a9a9a; --text-muted:#5a5a5a;
  --gold:#d4af37; --gold-dim:rgba(212,175,55,.08); --gold-glow:rgba(212,175,55,.3);
  --red:#c94040; --teal:#3bb39a; --blue:#7cc7ff; --purple:#a78bfa; --green:#7fc77f;
  --serif:'Crimson Text',Georgia,serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
  --display:'Oswald','Inter',sans-serif;
  --sans:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --max:1140px; --header-h:48px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

/* ═══════ TOP BAR ═══════ */
.tp-top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);height:var(--header-h)}
.tp-top-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;height:100%;padding:0 1.2rem;gap:.6rem}
.tp-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:.2rem .4rem .2rem 0;border-radius:4px;transition:background .3s}
.tp-brand-chi{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1;transition:all .3s}
.tp-brand-name{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .3s}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-chi{text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-name{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-brand::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-glow),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .4s ease}
.tp-brand:hover::after{width:140px;height:140px;opacity:1}
.tp-div{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border-2);flex-shrink:0;margin:0 .3rem}

/* Left nav */
.tp-nav-links{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center}
.tp-nav-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.32rem .55rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-nav-link:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-nav-link.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.08)}
.tp-nav-link i{margin-right:.3rem;font-size:.55rem}
.tp-nav-link::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.15),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .3s}
.tp-nav-link:hover::after{width:60px;height:60px;opacity:1}
.tp-spacer{flex:1}

/* Reading levels */
.tp-levels{display:flex;gap:2px;background:var(--surface2);padding:3px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-level{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-level:hover{color:var(--text)}
.tp-level.active{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.15);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
.tp-level::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.2),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .35s}
.tp-level:hover::after{width:80px;height:80px;opacity:1}
.tp-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.35rem .6rem;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.7rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.tp-search:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-search kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:2px}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}

/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR ═══════ */
.tp-class{position:fixed;top:var(--header-h);left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.4rem 0}

.tp-class-center{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem}

.tp-class-seg{transition:flex .4s ease;position:relative}
.tp-class-seg::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}

.tp-class-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s}
.tp-class-tag:hover{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-class-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 4px currentColor}
/* Small nav */
.tp-class-nav{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.25rem .5rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-class-nav:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15)}

/* ═══════ ARTICLE BODY ═══════ */
.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:calc(var(--header-h) + 68px) 1.5rem 3rem}

.tp-article h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;margin:3rem 0 1rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:-.01em}

.tp-article blockquote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem}

.tp-article pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-dim)}

/* ═══════ BIG PREV / NEXT NAV ═══════ */
.tp-bignav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-bignav-row{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:1rem}
.tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;transition:all .3s;min-height:90px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.tp-bignav-prev::before,.tp-bignav-next::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--hover-x,50%) var(--hover-y,50%),rgba(212,175,55,.06),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover::before,.tp-bignav-next:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover,.tp-bignav-next:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}

.tp-bignav-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem}
.tp-bignav-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-bignav-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;transition:color .2s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-title,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-title{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-bignav-prev .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-right:1.2rem}
.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:1.2rem}

/* Center: Series Home + Site Home */
.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:140px}
.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;transition:all .25s;text-align:center;background:var(--surface2)}
.tp-bignav-series:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(212,175,55,.12);background:var(--surface)}
.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em}
.tp-bignav-home:hover{color:var(--gold)}

@media(max-width:650px){
  .tp-bignav-row{flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}
  .tp-bignav-center{flex-direction:row;gap:1rem;padding:.6rem 0;order:-1;justify-content:center}
  .tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{padding:1.2rem 1rem}
  .tp-bignav-title{font-size:1rem}
}

/* ═══════ FINAL AUDIT ═══════ */
.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}
.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:60%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.4}
.tp-audit-head{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem}
.tp-audit-intro{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 auto .8rem;max-width:640px;line-height:1.6}
.tp-audit-covenant{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0 auto 2rem;max-width:640px;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;border-left:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);border-right:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);background:rgba(212,175,55,.04);line-height:1.6;font-style:italic}
.tp-audit-covenant b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;font-style:normal}
.tp-audit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;text-align:left}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-audit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.tp-audit-col{padding:1.2rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-col::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(255,255,255,.03),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-audit-col:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-audit-col:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.tp-audit-col h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.tp-audit-col ul{list-style:none;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.55}
.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.tp-audit-col li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.tp-col-right{border-color:rgba(59,179,154,.2)}.tp-col-right h4{color:var(--teal)}
.tp-col-right:hover{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(59,179,154,.1)}
.tp-col-over{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}.tp-col-over h4{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-col-over:hover{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-col-wrong{border-color:rgba(201,64,64,.2)}.tp-col-wrong h4{color:var(--red)}

/* ═══════ GOLD DIVIDER ═══════ */
.tp-gold-divider{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}
.tp-gold-divider-line{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(212,175,55,.3),transparent)}

/* ═══════ SUBDOMAIN GRID ═══════ */
.tp-subdomains{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem}

.tp-sub-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:1.3rem .8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;transition:all .35s;text-align:center;min-height:100px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}

.tp-sub-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}

/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */
.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}
.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-series-strip a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-series-strip a.soon{opacity:.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}
.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}

/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */
.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}
.tp-bottom-eq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.6rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
.tp-bottom-copy{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.68rem;margin:.25rem 0}
.tp-bottom-vow{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.82rem;margin-top:.8rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem}

/* ═══════ 15 + 15 = 100 (THE DOOR) ═══════ */
.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-gold 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse-gold{0%,100%{opacity:.6}50%{opacity:1}}
.tp-door-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:.5rem;cursor:default;transition:all .5s;position:relative}
.tp-door-num:hover{text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--gold-glow),0 0 60px rgba(212,175,55,.2);letter-spacing:.22em}

.tp-door-mark{display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:1.2rem auto 0;opacity:.4}

/* ═══════ SCROLLBAR ═══════ */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border-2);border-radius:3px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--border-hi)}

/* ═══════ SELECTION ═══════ */
::selection{background:rgba(212,175,55,.2);color:var(--text)}

/* ═══════ VERIFIED BAR PINNED UNDER TOP BAR — full-bleed, sticky ═══════ */

.verification-bar.tp-verify-top{

  position:sticky;top:var(--header-h);z-index:90;

  left:auto;right:auto;width:100%;

  margin:var(--header-h) 0 0;

  background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);

  border:1px solid rgba(20,184,166,.55);border-top:0;

}

.verification-bar.tp-verify-top .verification-toggle:hover{background:rgba(20,184,166,.04)}

}

.v-chip.on{border-color:var(--chip-color,#222);color:var(--chip-color,#5a5a5a);background:transparent;opacity:.5}

@media(max-width:700px){.v-domain-chips{display:none}}



/* ═══════ ARTICLE BODY ═══════ */

.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem}

.tp-article .byline{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:2.5rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}

.tp-article h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;margin:3rem 0 1rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:-.01em}

.tp-article blockquote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem}

.tp-article ul,.tp-article ol{margin:1rem 0 1.5rem 1.5rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.7}

.tp-article li{margin-bottom:.4rem}

.tp-article code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85rem;background:var(--surface2);padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:3px;color:var(--gold)}

.tp-article pre{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:1rem;overflow-x:auto;margin:1.5rem 0}

.tp-article pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-dim)}

/* empty-body placeholder (template only — delete when filling in) */

.tp-template-placeholder{min-height:40vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px dashed var(--border-2);border-radius:10px;color:var(--text-muted);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:1rem}



/* ═══════ BIG PREV / NEXT NAV ═══════ */

.tp-bignav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:.4rem 1.5rem 2.5rem}

.tp-bignav-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem}

.tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:.55rem .5rem;background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;transition:all .3s;min-height:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.tp-bignav-prev{justify-content:flex-start}

.tp-bignav-next{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}

.tp-bignav-prev::before,.tp-bignav-next::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--hover-x,50%) var(--hover-y,50%),rgba(20,184,166,.08),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}

.tp-bignav-prev:hover::before,.tp-bignav-next:hover::before{opacity:1}

.tp-bignav-prev:hover,.tp-bignav-next:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}

.tp-bignav-arrow{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .3s;flex-shrink:0}

.tp-bignav-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.1rem}

.tp-bignav-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}

.tp-bignav-prev .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-right:.7rem}

.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:.7rem}



/* Center: Series Home (no box) + Site Home (the prominent box) */

.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.35rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:170px}

.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.2rem .4rem;border:0;background:transparent;transition:all .25s;text-align:center}

.tp-bignav-series:hover{color:var(--gold)}

.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.7rem 1.4rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;background:var(--surface2);transition:all .25s;margin-top:.3rem;text-align:center}

.tp-bignav-home:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(20,184,166,.14);background:var(--surface)}



@media(max-width:650px){

  .tp-bignav-row{flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}

  .tp-bignav-center{flex-direction:row;gap:1rem;padding:.6rem 0;order:-1;justify-content:center}

  .tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{padding:1.2rem 1rem}

  .tp-bignav-title{font-size:1rem}

}



/* ═══════ FINAL AUDIT ═══════ */

.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}

.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.tp-audit-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:60%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.4}

.tp-audit-head{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem}

.tp-audit-intro{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 auto .8rem;max-width:640px;line-height:1.6}

.tp-audit-covenant{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0 auto 2rem;max-width:640px;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;border-left:2px solid rgba(20,184,166,.3);border-right:2px solid rgba(20,184,166,.3);background:rgba(20,184,166,.04);line-height:1.6;font-style:italic}

.tp-audit-covenant b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;font-style:normal}

.tp-audit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;text-align:left}

@media(max-width:700px){.tp-audit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.tp-audit-col{padding:1.2rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.tp-audit-col::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(255,255,255,.03),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}

.tp-audit-col:hover::before{opacity:1}

.tp-audit-col:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}

.tp-audit-col h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.8rem}

.tp-audit-col ul{list-style:none;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.55}

.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}

.tp-audit-col li:last-child{border-bottom:0}

.tp-col-right{border-color:rgba(59,179,154,.2)}.tp-col-right h4{color:var(--teal)}

.tp-col-right:hover{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(59,179,154,.1)}

.tp-col-over{border-color:rgba(20,184,166,.2)}.tp-col-over h4{color:var(--gold)}

.tp-col-over:hover{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(20,184,166,.1)}

.tp-col-wrong{border-color:rgba(201,64,64,.2)}.tp-col-wrong h4{color:var(--red)}

.tp-col-wrong:hover{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(201,64,64,.1)}



/* ═══════ GOLD DIVIDER ═══════ */

.tp-teal-divider{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}

.tp-teal-divider-line{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(20,184,166,.3),transparent)}



/* ═══════ SUBDOMAIN GRID ═══════ */

.tp-subdomains{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:1.3rem 1.5rem}

.tp-sub-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:.35rem}

.tp-sub-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(20,184,166,.3)}

.tp-sub-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}

.tp-sub-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.7rem}

.tp-sub-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:.55rem}

@media(max-width:900px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}

@media(max-width:550px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

.tp-sub-card{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:.55rem;padding:.75rem .8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;transition:all .35s;text-align:left;min-height:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}

.tp-sub-card i{font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .35s;flex-shrink:0}

.tp-sub-card h4{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);margin:0;line-height:1.2;transition:color .3s}

.tp-sub-card p{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.5rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0;line-height:1.25;transition:color .3s}

.tp-sub-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,rgba(20,184,166,.1),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s}

.tp-sub-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(20,184,166,.12)}

.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}

.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}

.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}

.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}



/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */

.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}

.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}

.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}

.tp-series-strip a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(20,184,166,.15);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(20,184,166,.1)}

.tp-series-strip a.soon{opacity:.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}

.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(20,184,166,.2)}



/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */

.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}

.tp-bottom-eq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.6rem;letter-spacing:.05em}

.tp-bottom-copy{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.68rem;margin:.25rem 0}

.tp-bottom-vow{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.82rem;margin-top:.8rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem}



/* ═══════ 15 + 15 = 100 (THE DOOR) ═══════ */

.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}

.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(20,184,166,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-teal 4s ease-in-out infinite}

@keyframes pulse-teal{0%,100%{opacity:.6}50%{opacity:1}}

.tp-door-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:.5rem;cursor:default;transition:all .5s;position:relative}

.tp-door-num:hover{text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--gold-glow),0 0 60px rgba(20,184,166,.2);letter-spacing:.22em}

.tp-door-sub{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .3s;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.5}

.tp-door:hover .tp-door-sub{color:var(--text-dim)}

.tp-door-mark{display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:1.2rem auto 0;opacity:.4}



/* ═══════ SCROLLBAR ═══════ */

::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border-2);border-radius:3px}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--border-hi)}



/* ═══════ SELECTION ═══════ */

::selection{background:rgba(20,184,166,.2);color:var(--text)}

</style>

<style>

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}

.tp-brand:hover::after{width:140px;height:140px;opacity:1}

/* Left nav */
.tp-nav-links{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center}

/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR ═══════ */
.tp-class{position:fixed;top:var(--header-h);left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.4rem 0}

.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:calc(var(--header-h) + 68px) 1.5rem 3rem}

.tp-article h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;margin:3rem 0 1rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:-.01em}

.tp-article blockquote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem}

.tp-article pre{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:1rem;overflow-x:auto;margin:1.5rem 0}

/* ═══════ BIG PREV / NEXT NAV ═══════ */
.tp-bignav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-bignav-row{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:1rem}
.tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;transition:all .3s;min-height:90px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.tp-bignav-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem}
.tp-bignav-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-bignav-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;transition:color .2s}

.tp-bignav-prev .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-right:1.2rem}
.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:1.2rem}

.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em}

@media(max-width:650px){
  .tp-bignav-row{flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}
  .tp-bignav-center{flex-direction:row;gap:1rem;padding:.6rem 0;order:-1;justify-content:center}
  .tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{padding:1.2rem 1rem}
  .tp-bignav-title{font-size:1rem}
}

/* ═══════ FINAL AUDIT ═══════ */
.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}
.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

.tp-audit-head{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem}
.tp-audit-intro{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 auto .8rem;max-width:640px;line-height:1.6}
.tp-audit-covenant{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0 auto 2rem;max-width:640px;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;border-left:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);border-right:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);background:rgba(212,175,55,.04);line-height:1.6;font-style:italic}
.tp-audit-covenant b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;font-style:normal}
.tp-audit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;text-align:left}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-audit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.tp-audit-col{padding:1.2rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-col::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(255,255,255,.03),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-audit-col:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-audit-col:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.tp-audit-col h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.8rem}

.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}

.tp-gold-divider{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}
.tp-gold-divider-line{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(212,175,55,.3),transparent)}

.tp-sub-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.tp-sub-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:.7rem}
@media(max-width:900px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:550px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.tp-sub-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:1.3rem .8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;transition:all .35s;text-align:center;min-height:100px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}

.tp-sub-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}

/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */
.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}
.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-series-strip a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-series-strip a.soon{opacity:.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}
.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}

/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */
.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}
.tp-bottom-eq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.6rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
.tp-bottom-copy{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.68rem;margin:.25rem 0}
.tp-bottom-vow{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.82rem;margin-top:.8rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem}

/* ═══════ 15 + 15 = 100 (THE DOOR) ═══════ */
.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-gold 4s ease-in-out infinite}

.tp-door-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:.5rem;cursor:default;transition:all .5s;position:relative}
.tp-door-num:hover{text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--gold-glow),0 0 60px rgba(212,175,55,.2);letter-spacing:.22em}
.tp-door-sub{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .3s;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.5}
.tp-door:hover .tp-door-sub{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-door-mark{display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:1.2rem auto 0;opacity:.4}

/* ═══════ SCROLLBAR ═══════ */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border-2);border-radius:3px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--border-hi)}

::selection{background:rgba(212,175,55,.2);color:var(--text)}

/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR (inside header lip) ═══════ */

.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}

.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}

.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}

<style>

:root {

  --bg:#050505; --surface:#0a0a0a; --surface2:#111; --surface3:#1a1a1a;

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}

/* Left nav */

.tp-nav-links{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center}

.tp-levels{display:flex;gap:2px;background:var(--surface2);padding:3px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}

.tp-level{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}

@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}



/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR (inside header lip) ═══════ */

.tp-class{position:fixed;top:var(--header-h);left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.4rem 0}

.tp-canon-chip{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;line-height:1;padding:.22rem .48rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(20,184,166,.18);color:var(--text-muted);background:rgba(20,184,166,.055);max-width:18rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}

.tp-canon-chip.summary{flex:1 1 18rem;color:var(--text-dim);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}

.tp-class-nav{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.25rem .5rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent}

.tp-class-nav:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(20,184,166,.15)}

@media(max-width:600px){.tp-class-tags,.tp-canon-meta{display:none}}



/* ═══════ VERIFIED BAR PINNED UNDER TOP BAR — full-bleed, sticky ═══════ */

/* ═══════ ARTICLE BODY ═══════ */

.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem}

.tp-article h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.6rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em}

<style>
:root {
  --bg:#050505; --surface:#0a0a0a; --surface2:#111; --surface3:#1a1a1a;
  --border:#222; --border-2:#2a2a2a; --border-hi:#3a3a3a;
  --text:#e5e3df; --text-dim:#9a9a9a; --text-muted:#5a5a5a;
  --gold:#d4af37; --gold-dim:rgba(212,175,55,.08); --gold-glow:rgba(212,175,55,.3);
  --red:#c94040; --teal:#3bb39a; --blue:#7cc7ff; --purple:#a78bfa; --green:#7fc77f;
  --serif:'Crimson Text',Georgia,serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
  --display:'Oswald','Inter',sans-serif;
  --sans:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --max:1140px; --header-h:48px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

/* ═══════ TOP BAR ═══════ */
.tp-top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);height:var(--header-h)}
.tp-top-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;height:100%;padding:0 1.2rem;gap:.6rem}
.tp-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:.2rem .4rem .2rem 0;border-radius:4px;transition:background .3s}
.tp-brand-chi{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1;transition:all .3s}
.tp-brand-name{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .3s}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-chi{text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-name{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-brand::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-glow),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .4s ease}
.tp-brand:hover::after{width:140px;height:140px;opacity:1}
.tp-div{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border-2);flex-shrink:0;margin:0 .3rem}

/* Left nav */
.tp-nav-links{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center}
.tp-nav-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.32rem .55rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-nav-link:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-nav-link.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.08)}
.tp-nav-link i{margin-right:.3rem;font-size:.55rem}
.tp-nav-link::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.15),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .3s}
.tp-nav-link:hover::after{width:60px;height:60px;opacity:1}
.tp-spacer{flex:1}

/* Reading levels */
.tp-levels{display:flex;gap:2px;background:var(--surface2);padding:3px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-level{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-level:hover{color:var(--text)}
.tp-level.active{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.15);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
.tp-level::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.2),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .35s}
.tp-level:hover::after{width:80px;height:80px;opacity:1}
.tp-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.35rem .6rem;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.7rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.tp-search:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-search kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:2px}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}

/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR ═══════ */
.tp-class{position:fixed;top:var(--header-h);left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.4rem 0}
.tp-class-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}
.tp-class-center{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem}
.tp-class-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-class-bar{display:flex;height:5px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;gap:1px}
.tp-class-seg{transition:flex .4s ease;position:relative}
.tp-class-seg::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-class-bar:hover .tp-class-seg::after{opacity:1}
.tp-class-tags{display:flex;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tp-class-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s}
.tp-class-tag:hover{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-class-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 4px currentColor}
/* Small nav */
.tp-class-nav{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.25rem .5rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent}

/* ═══════ ARTICLE BODY ═══════ */
.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:calc(var(--header-h) + 68px) 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-article h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.6rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tp-article .subtitle{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.2rem;line-height:1.4}
.tp-article .byline{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:2.5rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-article h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;margin:3rem 0 1rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tp-article h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;margin:2rem 0 .6rem}
.tp-article p{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.3rem;line-height:1.75}
.tp-article blockquote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem}
.tp-article ul,.tp-article ol{margin:1rem 0 1.5rem 1.5rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.7}
.tp-article li{margin-bottom:.4rem}
.tp-article code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85rem;background:var(--surface2);padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:3px;color:var(--gold)}
.tp-article pre{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:1rem;overflow-x:auto;margin:1.5rem 0}
.tp-article pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-dim)}

/* ═══════ BIG PREV / NEXT NAV ═══════ */
.tp-bignav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-bignav-row{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:1rem}
.tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;transition:all .3s;min-height:90px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-bignav-prev{justify-content:flex-start}
.tp-bignav-next{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}
.tp-bignav-prev::before,.tp-bignav-next::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--hover-x,50%) var(--hover-y,50%),rgba(212,175,55,.06),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover::before,.tp-bignav-next:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover,.tp-bignav-next:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-bignav-arrow{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .3s;flex-shrink:0}

.tp-bignav-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem}

.tp-bignav-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;transition:color .2s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-title,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-title{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-bignav-prev .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-right:1.2rem}
.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:1.2rem}

/* Center: Series Home + Site Home */
.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:140px}
.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;transition:all .25s;text-align:center;background:var(--surface2)}
.tp-bignav-series:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(212,175,55,.12);background:var(--surface)}
.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em}

@media(max-width:650px){

/* ═══════ FINAL AUDIT ═══════ */
.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}
.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:60%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.4}

.tp-audit-intro{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 auto .8rem;max-width:640px;line-height:1.6}
.tp-audit-covenant{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0 auto 2rem;max-width:640px;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;border-left:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);border-right:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);background:rgba(212,175,55,.04);line-height:1.6;font-style:italic}
.tp-audit-covenant b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;font-style:normal}
.tp-audit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;text-align:left}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-audit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.tp-audit-col{padding:1.2rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-col::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(255,255,255,.03),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-audit-col:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-audit-col:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.tp-audit-col h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.tp-audit-col ul{list-style:none;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.55}
.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}

/* ═══════ GOLD DIVIDER ═══════ */
.tp-gold-divider{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}
.tp-gold-divider-line{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(212,175,55,.3),transparent)}

/* ═══════ SUBDOMAIN GRID ═══════ */
.tp-subdomains{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem}

@media(max-width:550px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

<style>
:root {
  --bg:#050505; --surface:#0a0a0a; --surface2:#111; --surface3:#1a1a1a;
  --border:#222; --border-2:#2a2a2a; --border-hi:#3a3a3a;
  --text:#e5e3df; --text-dim:#9a9a9a; --text-muted:#5a5a5a;
  --gold:#d4af37; --gold-dim:rgba(212,175,55,.08); --gold-glow:rgba(212,175,55,.3);
  --red:#c94040; --teal:#3bb39a; --blue:#7cc7ff; --purple:#a78bfa; --green:#7fc77f;
  --serif:'Crimson Text',Georgia,serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
  --display:'Oswald','Inter',sans-serif;
  --sans:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --max:1140px; --header-h:48px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

/* ═══════ TOP BAR ═══════ */
.tp-top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);height:var(--header-h)}
.tp-top-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;height:100%;padding:0 1.2rem;gap:.6rem}
.tp-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:.2rem .4rem .2rem 0;border-radius:4px;transition:background .3s}
.tp-brand-chi{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1;transition:all .3s}
.tp-brand-name{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .3s}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-chi{text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-name{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-brand::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-glow),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .4s ease}
.tp-brand:hover::after{width:140px;height:140px;opacity:1}
.tp-div{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border-2);flex-shrink:0;margin:0 .3rem}

/* Left nav */
.tp-nav-links{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center}
.tp-nav-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.32rem .55rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-nav-link:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-nav-link.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.08)}
.tp-nav-link i{margin-right:.3rem;font-size:.55rem}
.tp-nav-link::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.15),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .3s}
.tp-nav-link:hover::after{width:60px;height:60px;opacity:1}
.tp-spacer{flex:1}

/* Reading levels */
.tp-levels{display:flex;gap:2px;background:var(--surface2);padding:3px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-level{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-level:hover{color:var(--text)}
.tp-level.active{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.15);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
.tp-level::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.2),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .35s}
.tp-level:hover::after{width:80px;height:80px;opacity:1}
.tp-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.35rem .6rem;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.7rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.tp-search:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-search kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:2px}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}

/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR ═══════ */
.tp-class{position:fixed;top:var(--header-h);left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.4rem 0}
.tp-class-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}
.tp-class-center{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem}
.tp-class-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-class-bar{display:flex;height:5px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;gap:1px}
.tp-class-seg{transition:flex .4s ease;position:relative}
.tp-class-seg::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-class-bar:hover .tp-class-seg::after{opacity:1}
.tp-class-tags{display:flex;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tp-class-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s}
.tp-class-tag:hover{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-class-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 4px currentColor}
/* Small nav */
.tp-class-nav{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.25rem .5rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-class-nav:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15)}
@media(max-width:600px){.tp-class-tags{display:none}}

/* ═══════ ARTICLE BODY ═══════ */
.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:calc(var(--header-h) + 68px) 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-article h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.6rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tp-article .subtitle{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.2rem;line-height:1.4}
.tp-article .byline{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:2.5rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-article h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;margin:3rem 0 1rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tp-article h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;margin:2rem 0 .6rem}
.tp-article p{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.3rem;line-height:1.75}
.tp-article blockquote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem}
.tp-article ul,.tp-article ol{margin:1rem 0 1.5rem 1.5rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.7}
.tp-article li{margin-bottom:.4rem}
.tp-article code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85rem;background:var(--surface2);padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:3px;color:var(--gold)}
.tp-article pre{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:1rem;overflow-x:auto;margin:1.5rem 0}
.tp-article pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-dim)}

/* ═══════ BIG PREV / NEXT NAV ═══════ */
.tp-bignav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-bignav-row{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:1rem}
.tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;transition:all .3s;min-height:90px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-bignav-prev{justify-content:flex-start}
.tp-bignav-next{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}
.tp-bignav-prev::before,.tp-bignav-next::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--hover-x,50%) var(--hover-y,50%),rgba(212,175,55,.06),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover::before,.tp-bignav-next:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover,.tp-bignav-next:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-bignav-arrow{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .3s;flex-shrink:0}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-arrow,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-arrow{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.1)}
.tp-bignav-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem}
.tp-bignav-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-bignav-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;transition:color .2s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-title,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-title{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-bignav-prev .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-right:1.2rem}
.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:1.2rem}

/* Center: Series Home + Site Home */
.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:140px}
.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;transition:all .25s;text-align:center;background:var(--surface2)}
.tp-bignav-series:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(212,175,55,.12);background:var(--surface)}
.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em}
.tp-bignav-home:hover{color:var(--gold)}

@media(max-width:650px){
  .tp-bignav-row{flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}
  .tp-bignav-center{flex-direction:row;gap:1rem;padding:.6rem 0;order:-1;justify-content:center}
  .tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{padding:1.2rem 1rem}
  .tp-bignav-title{font-size:1rem}
}

/* ═══════ FINAL AUDIT ═══════ */
.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}
.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:60%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.4}
.tp-audit-head{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem}
.tp-audit-intro{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 auto .8rem;max-width:640px;line-height:1.6}
.tp-audit-covenant{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0 auto 2rem;max-width:640px;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;border-left:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);border-right:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);background:rgba(212,175,55,.04);line-height:1.6;font-style:italic}
.tp-audit-covenant b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;font-style:normal}
.tp-audit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;text-align:left}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-audit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.tp-audit-col{padding:1.2rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-col::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(255,255,255,.03),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-audit-col:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-audit-col:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.tp-audit-col h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.tp-audit-col ul{list-style:none;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.55}
.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.tp-audit-col li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.tp-col-right{border-color:rgba(59,179,154,.2)}.tp-col-right h4{color:var(--teal)}
.tp-col-right:hover{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(59,179,154,.1)}
.tp-col-over{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}.tp-col-over h4{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-col-over:hover{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-col-wrong{border-color:rgba(201,64,64,.2)}.tp-col-wrong h4{color:var(--red)}
.tp-col-wrong:hover{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(201,64,64,.1)}

/* ═══════ GOLD DIVIDER ═══════ */
.tp-gold-divider{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}
.tp-gold-divider-line{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(212,175,55,.3),transparent)}

/* ═══════ SUBDOMAIN GRID ═══════ */
.tp-subdomains{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem}
.tp-sub-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.tp-sub-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(212,175,55,.3)}
.tp-sub-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-sub-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.tp-sub-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:.7rem}
@media(max-width:900px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:550px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.tp-sub-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:1.3rem .8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;transition:all .35s;text-align:center;min-height:100px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}
.tp-sub-card i{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .35s}
.tp-sub-card h4{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);margin:0;line-height:1.25;transition:color .3s}
.tp-sub-card p{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0;transition:color .3s}
.tp-sub-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,rgba(212,175,55,.1),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s}
.tp-sub-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}

/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */
.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}
.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-series-strip a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-series-strip a.soon{opacity:.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}
.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}

/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */
.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}
.tp-bottom-eq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.6rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
.tp-bottom-copy{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.68rem;margin:.25rem 0}
.tp-bottom-vow{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.82rem;margin-top:.8rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem}

/* ═══════ 15 + 15 = 100 (THE DOOR) ═══════ */
.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-gold 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse-gold{0%,100%{opacity:.6}50%{opacity:1}}
.tp-door-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:.5rem;cursor:default;transition:all .5s;position:relative}
.tp-door-num:hover{text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--gold-glow),0 0 60px rgba(212,175,55,.2);letter-spacing:.22em}
.tp-door-sub{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .3s;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.5}
.tp-door:hover .tp-door-sub{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-door-mark{display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:1.2rem auto 0;opacity:.4}

/* ═══════ SCROLLBAR ═══════ */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border-2);border-radius:3px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--border-hi)}

/* ═══════ SELECTION ═══════ */
::selection{background:rgba(212,175,55,.2);color:var(--text)}
</style>

  --gold:#d4af37; --gold-dim:rgba(212,175,55,.08); --gold-glow:rgba(212,175,55,.3);
  --red:#c94040; --teal:#3bb39a; --blue:#7cc7ff; --purple:#a78bfa; --green:#7fc77f;

        :root {

            overflow: hidden;

        .card-image {

            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            background: #080808;
        }

        .card-image img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            transition: transform 0.6s ease, opacity 0.4s ease;
            opacity: 0.85;

        @media (max-width: 480px) {

  --text:#e5e3df; --text-dim:#9a9a9a; --text-muted:#5a5a5a;
  --gold:#d4af37; --gold-dim:rgba(212,175,55,.08); --gold-glow:rgba(212,175,55,.3);
  --red:#c94040; --teal:#3bb39a; --blue:#7cc7ff; --purple:#a78bfa; --green:#7fc77f;
  --serif:'Crimson Text',Georgia,serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
  --display:'Oswald','Inter',sans-serif;
  --sans:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --max:1140px; --header-h:48px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

/* ═══════ TOP BAR ═══════ */
.tp-top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);height:var(--header-h)}
.tp-top-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;height:100%;padding:0 1.2rem;gap:.6rem}
.tp-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:.2rem .4rem .2rem 0;border-radius:4px;transition:background .3s}
.tp-brand-chi{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1;transition:all .3s}
.tp-brand-name{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .3s}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-chi{text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-name{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-brand::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-glow),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .4s ease}
.tp-brand:hover::after{width:140px;height:140px;opacity:1}
.tp-div{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border-2);flex-shrink:0;margin:0 .3rem}

/* Left nav */
.tp-nav-links{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center}
.tp-nav-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.32rem .55rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-nav-link:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-nav-link.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.08)}
.tp-nav-link i{margin-right:.3rem;font-size:.55rem}
.tp-nav-link::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.15),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .3s}
.tp-nav-link:hover::after{width:60px;height:60px;opacity:1}
.tp-spacer{flex:1}

/* Reading levels */
.tp-levels{display:flex;gap:2px;background:var(--surface2);padding:3px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-level{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-level:hover{color:var(--text)}
.tp-level.active{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.15);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
.tp-level::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.2),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .35s}
.tp-level:hover::after{width:80px;height:80px;opacity:1}
.tp-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.35rem .6rem;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.7rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.tp-search:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-search kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:2px}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}

/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR ═══════ */
.tp-class{position:fixed;top:var(--header-h);left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.4rem 0}
.tp-class-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}
.tp-class-center{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem}
.tp-class-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-class-bar{display:flex;height:5px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;gap:1px}
.tp-class-seg{transition:flex .4s ease;position:relative}
.tp-class-seg::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-class-bar:hover .tp-class-seg::after{opacity:1}
.tp-class-tags{display:flex;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tp-class-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s}
.tp-class-tag:hover{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-class-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 4px currentColor}
/* Small nav */
.tp-class-nav{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.25rem .5rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-class-nav:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15)}
@media(max-width:600px){.tp-class-tags{display:none}}

/* ═══════ ARTICLE BODY ═══════ */
.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:calc(var(--header-h) + 68px) 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-article h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.6rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em}

.tp-article .byline{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:2.5rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-article h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;margin:3rem 0 1rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tp-article h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;margin:2rem 0 .6rem}
.tp-article p{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.3rem;line-height:1.75}
.tp-article blockquote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem}
