/* Reading levels */
.tp-levels{display:flex;gap:2px;background:var(--surface2);padding:3px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-level{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-level:hover{color:var(--text)}
.tp-level.active{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.15);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
.tp-level::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.2),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .35s}
.tp-level:hover::after{width:80px;height:80px;opacity:1}
.tp-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.35rem .6rem;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.7rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.tp-search:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-search kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:2px}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}

/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR ═══════ */
.tp-class{position:fixed;top:var(--header-h);left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.4rem 0}
.tp-class-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}
.tp-class-center{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem}
.tp-class-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-class-bar{display:flex;height:5px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;gap:1px}
.tp-class-seg{transition:flex .4s ease;position:relative}
.tp-class-seg::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-class-bar:hover .tp-class-seg::after{opacity:1}
.tp-class-tags{display:flex;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tp-class-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s}
.tp-class-tag:hover{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-class-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 4px currentColor}
/* Small nav */
.tp-class-nav{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.25rem .5rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-class-nav:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15)}
@media(max-width:600px){.tp-class-tags{display:none}}

/* ═══════ ARTICLE BODY ═══════ */
.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:calc(var(--header-h) + 68px) 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-article h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.6rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tp-article .subtitle{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.2rem;line-height:1.4}
.tp-article .byline{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:2.5rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-article h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;margin:3rem 0 1rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tp-article h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;margin:2rem 0 .6rem}
.tp-article p{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:1.3rem;line-height:1.75}
.tp-article blockquote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem}
.tp-article ul,.tp-article ol{margin:1rem 0 1.5rem 1.5rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.7}
.tp-article li{margin-bottom:.4rem}
.tp-article code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85rem;background:var(--surface2);padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:3px;color:var(--gold)}
.tp-article pre{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:1rem;overflow-x:auto;margin:1.5rem 0}
.tp-article pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-dim)}

/* ═══════ BIG PREV / NEXT NAV ═══════ */
.tp-bignav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-bignav-row{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:1rem}
.tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;transition:all .3s;min-height:90px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-bignav-prev{justify-content:flex-start}
.tp-bignav-next{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}
.tp-bignav-prev::before,.tp-bignav-next::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--hover-x,50%) var(--hover-y,50%),rgba(212,175,55,.06),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover::before,.tp-bignav-next:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover,.tp-bignav-next:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-bignav-arrow{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .3s;flex-shrink:0}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-arrow,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-arrow{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.1)}
.tp-bignav-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem}
.tp-bignav-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-bignav-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;transition:color .2s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-title,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-title{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-bignav-prev .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-right:1.2rem}
.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:1.2rem}

/* Center: Series Home + Site Home */
.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:140px}
.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;transition:all .25s;text-align:center;background:var(--surface2)}
.tp-bignav-series:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(212,175,55,.12);background:var(--surface)}
.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em}
.tp-bignav-home:hover{color:var(--gold)}

@media(max-width:650px){
  .tp-bignav-row{flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}
  .tp-bignav-center{flex-direction:row;gap:1rem;padding:.6rem 0;order:-1;justify-content:center}
  .tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{padding:1.2rem 1rem}
  .tp-bignav-title{font-size:1rem}
}

/* ═══════ FINAL AUDIT ═══════ */
.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}
.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:60%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.4}
.tp-audit-head{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem}
.tp-audit-intro{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 auto .8rem;max-width:640px;line-height:1.6}
.tp-audit-covenant{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0 auto 2rem;max-width:640px;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;border-left:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);border-right:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);background:rgba(212,175,55,.04);line-height:1.6;font-style:italic}
.tp-audit-covenant b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;font-style:normal}
.tp-audit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;text-align:left}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-audit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.tp-audit-col{padding:1.2rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-col::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(255,255,255,.03),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-audit-col:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-audit-col:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.tp-audit-col h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.tp-audit-col ul{list-style:none;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.55}
.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.tp-audit-col li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.tp-col-right{border-color:rgba(59,179,154,.2)}.tp-col-right h4{color:var(--teal)}
.tp-col-right:hover{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(59,179,154,.1)}
.tp-col-over{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}.tp-col-over h4{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-col-over:hover{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-col-wrong{border-color:rgba(201,64,64,.2)}.tp-col-wrong h4{color:var(--red)}
.tp-col-wrong:hover{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(201,64,64,.1)}

/* ═══════ GOLD DIVIDER ═══════ */
.tp-gold-divider{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}
.tp-gold-divider-line{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(212,175,55,.3),transparent)}

/* ═══════ SUBDOMAIN GRID ═══════ */
.tp-subdomains{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem}
.tp-sub-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.tp-sub-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(212,175,55,.3)}
.tp-sub-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-sub-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.tp-sub-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:.7rem}
@media(max-width:900px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:550px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.tp-sub-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:1.3rem .8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;transition:all .35s;text-align:center;min-height:100px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}
.tp-sub-card i{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .35s}
.tp-sub-card h4{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);margin:0;line-height:1.25;transition:color .3s}
.tp-sub-card p{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0;transition:color .3s}
.tp-sub-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,rgba(212,175,55,.1),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s}
.tp-sub-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}

/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */
.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}
.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-series-strip a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-series-strip a.soon{opacity:.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}
.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}

/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */
.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}
.tp-bottom-eq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.6rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
.tp-bottom-copy{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.68rem;margin:.25rem 0}
.tp-bottom-vow{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.82rem;margin-top:.8rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem}

/* ═══════ 15 + 15 = 100 (THE DOOR) ═══════ */
.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-gold 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse-gold{0%,100%{opacity:.6}50%{opacity:1}}
.tp-door-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:.5rem;cursor:default;transition:all .5s;position:relative}
.tp-door-num:hover{text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--gold-glow),0 0 60px rgba(212,175,55,.2);letter-spacing:.22em}
.tp-door-sub{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .3s;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.5}
.tp-door:hover .tp-door-sub{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-door-mark{display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:1.2rem auto 0;opacity:.4}

/* ═══════ SCROLLBAR ═══════ */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border-2);border-radius:3px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--border-hi)}

/* ═══════ SELECTION ═══════ */
::selection{background:rgba(212,175,55,.2);color:var(--text)}
</style>

<style>
.serif{font-family:'Crimson Text',serif;}
.display{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

:root{--bg:#0a0a0f;--bg2:#12121a;--card:#16161f;--card-h:#1c1c28;--t1:#e8e6e1;--t2:#9a9690;--t3:#5a5752;--gold:#c9a84c;--gold-d:#8a7233;--blue:#4a7fb5;--teal:#3a9d8f;--rose:#b54a6a;--purple:#7a5ab5;--bdr:rgba(201,168,76,.08);--bdr-h:rgba(201,168,76,.2);--glow:rgba(201,168,76,.12);--ff:'Crimson Text',Georgia,serif;--fb:'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;--fm:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;--r:8px;--tr:.25s ease}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{font-family:var(--fb);background:var(--bg);color:var(--t1);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
::selection{background:var(--gold);color:var(--bg)}

/* HERO */
.hero{position:relative;padding:72px 40px 56px;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr)}
.hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 700px 350px at 50% 0%,var(--glow),transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 500px 250px at 20% 80%,rgba(122,90,181,.05),transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 500px 250px at 80% 80%,rgba(58,157,143,.05),transparent);pointer-events:none}
.hero-label{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-d);margin-bottom:14px;position:relative}
.hero h1{font-family:var(--ff);font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6vw,4.2rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:10px;position:relative}
.hero h1 .g{color:var(--gold)}
.hero-sub{font-family:var(--ff);font-size:18px;font-style:italic;color:var(--t2);position:relative;margin-bottom:16px}
.hero-desc{font-size:14px;color:var(--t3);max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;line-height:1.7}
.hero-stats{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:28px;margin-top:20px;position:relative}
.stat .num{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:24px;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}
.stat .lbl{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--t3);margin-top:2px}

/* TOOLBAR */
.toolbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(10,10,15,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);padding:10px 40px}
.tool-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.search{font-family:var(--fb);font-size:13px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:100px;border:1px solid var(--bdr);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);color:var(--t1);width:220px;outline:0;transition:var(--tr)}.search:focus{border-color:var(--gold-d);width:280px}.search::placeholder{color:var(--t3)}
.count{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:10px;color:var(--t3);letter-spacing:1px;margin-left:auto}

/* ALPHABET NAV */
.alpha-nav{display:flex;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:6px 40px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);background:rgba(10,10,15,.6)}
.alpha-btn{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:11px;width:28px;height:28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid transparent;background:0;color:var(--t3);cursor:pointer;transition:var(--tr)}
.alpha-btn:hover{color:var(--t2);border-color:var(--bdr)}
.alpha-btn.on{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold-d);background:rgba(201,168,76,.06)}
.alpha-btn.disabled{opacity:.25;cursor:default}

/* CATEGORY PILLS */
.cats{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px 40px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr)}
.pill{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:100px;border:1px solid var(--bdr);background:0;color:var(--t3);cursor:pointer;transition:var(--tr);white-space:nowrap}
.pill:hover{border-color:var(--bdr-h);color:var(--t2)}
.pill.on{border-color:var(--gold-d);color:var(--gold);background:rgba(201,168,76,.06)}
.pill .n{opacity:.4;margin-left:3px}

/* TERM LIST */
.terms{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 40px 60px}
.letter-group{margin-bottom:32px}
.letter-head{font-family:var(--ff);font-size:36px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold-d);margin-bottom:12px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr)}

/* TERM CARD */
.term{padding:14px 18px;border-radius:var(--r);border:1px solid var(--bdr);background:var(--card);margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:var(--tr)}
.term:hover{border-color:var(--bdr-h);background:var(--card-h)}
.term.open{border-color:var(--bdr-h)}
.term-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.term-name{font-family:var(--ff);font-size:20px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
.term-cat{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:100px;border:1px solid var(--bdr);color:var(--t3);white-space:nowrap}
.term-tier{font-family:var(--fm);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-d);margin-left:auto}
.term-desc{font-size:13px;color:var(--t2);line-height:1.7;margin-top:8px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}

<style>

/* ── HERO ── */
.hero{padding:5rem 0 3.5rem;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}

  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:1.5rem;display:block}

.hero h1 span{color:var(--accent)}

.hero .pillars{
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:.6rem;
  max-width:600px;margin:0 auto}
.hero .pill{

  text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .9rem;

  background:var(--surface);transition:all .3s}

/* ── SECTION LABEL ── */

  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;
  margin:3.5rem 0 1.5rem}

/* ── ARTICLE CARDS ── */
.card-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;background:var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:4rem}

.card{
  background:var(--surface);padding:1.8rem 2rem;

  align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;transition:background .25s}
.card:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
.card:hover .card-title{color:var(--accent)}
.card:hover .card-arrow{color:var(--accent);transform:translateX(3px)}

.card-act{

  letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;

  padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap;
  min-width:58px;text-align:center}

.card-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.35rem}

  font-family:'Crimson Text',serif;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600;
  color:#fff;line-height:1.3;transition:color .25s}
.card-desc{
  font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.65}

.card-arrow{
  font-size:.85rem;color:var(--border);transition:all .25s;padding-right:.25rem}

/* ── FOOTER ── */
.foot{
  text-align:center;padding:2rem 0 4rem;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:1rem}
.foot p{
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.6rem;
  letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim)}

/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media(max-width:600px){
  .page{padding:0 1.2rem}
  .hero{padding:3.5rem 0 2.5rem}
  .card{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:.8rem;padding:1.4rem 1.3rem}
  .card-act{justify-self:start}
  .card-arrow{display:none}
  .hero .pillars{gap:.4rem}
  .hero .pill{font-size:.5rem;padding:.3rem .65rem}
}
</style>

<style>
.serif{font-family:'Crimson Text',serif;}
.display{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

        :root {
            --void: #050508;
            --ink: #0a0a0f;
            --surface: #111118;
            --surface-2: #1a1a24;
            --surface-3: #222230;
            --gold: #c9a84c;
            --gold-dim: #8a7a3a;
            --gold-bright: #e8d78a;
            --gold-glow: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15);
            --crimson: #8b2e2e;
            --crimson-glow: rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.2);
            --text: #d0d0d8;
            --text-dim: #6a6a78;
            --text-bright: #f0f0f5;
            --accent: #4a9eff;
            --accent-dim: #2a5a8a;
            --grid: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.06);
            --border: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.12);
            --border-hover: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.3);
            --success: #4a9e6a;
            --warning: #c9a84c;
            --danger: #c94a4a;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            background: var(--void);
            color: var(--text);
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Background Grid */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background-image: 
                linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* Ambient Glow */
        .ambient-glow {
            position: fixed;
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
            top: -200px;
            right: -200px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            animation: pulse-glow 8s ease-in-out infinite;

        .status-pending {

        /* Navigation Breadcrumb */

        /* Section Styles */

        }

        @keyframes pulse-arrow-reverse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: translateX(0); }
            50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-4px); }

        /* Tests Grid */

            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);

            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);

.serif{font-family:'Crimson Text',serif;}

        :root {

            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .mapping-node .node-value {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .mapping-arrow {
            font-size: 24px;
            color: var(--gold);
            animation: pulse-arrow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-arrow {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: translateX(0); }
            50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(4px); }
        }

        .mapping-arrow.reverse {
            animation: pulse-arrow-reverse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-arrow-reverse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: translateX(0); }
            50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-4px); }
        }

        /* Tests Grid */
        .tests-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .test-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 24px;

        .test-card:hover {

        }

        .test-card.pass {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--success);
        }

        .test-card.fail {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--danger);
        }

        .test-card.partial {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--warning);
        }

        .test-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .test-icon {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .test-card.pass .test-icon { background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.2); color: var(--success); }
        .test-card.fail .test-icon { background: rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.2); color: var(--danger); }
        .test-card.partial .test-icon { background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.2); color: var(--warning); }

        .test-name {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .test-desc {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .test-result {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .result-pass { background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.15); color: var(--success); }
        .result-fail { background: rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.15); color: var(--danger); }
        .result-partial { background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15); color: var(--warning); }

        /* Classification Panel */
        .class-panel {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface) 0%, var(--ink) 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 32px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .class-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .class-item {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 20px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .class-item .class-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .class-item .class-value {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .class-item .class-detail {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        /* Evidence Bar */
        .evidence-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            margin: 24px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .evidence-chip {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text);
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .evidence-chip:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold-bright);
        }

        .evidence-chip .chip-icon {
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Laws Invoked */
        .laws-grid {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            margin: 20px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .law-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface-2), var(--surface-3));
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .law-badge:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--gold-glow);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .law-badge .law-num {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold-bright);
        }

        /* Falsification Box */
        .falsification-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.1), rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.3);

            padding: 24px;
            margin: 24px 0;

        .falsification-box .fals-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--danger);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-content {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-content strong {
            color: var(--danger);
        }

        /* Quote Block */
        .quote-block {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            padding: 20px 24px;
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            margin: 24px 0;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.8;
            position: relative;
        }

        .quote-block::before {
            content: '\201C';
            position: absolute;
            top: 8px;
            left: 12px;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 48px;
            color: var(--gold);
            opacity: 0.2;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .quote-block p {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .quote-attribution {
            margin-top: 12px;
            font-style: normal;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
        }

        /* Related ISOs */
        .related-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .related-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 20px;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: block;
        }

        .related-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
            background: var(--surface-2);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .related-card .rel-id {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .related-card .rel-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .related-card .rel-level {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* Footer */
        .registry-footer {
            margin-top: 60px;
            padding: 40px 0;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .footer-brand {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .footer-meta {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .footer-seal {
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .domain-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .tests-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .class-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .related-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .hero-title { font-size: 24px; }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .container { padding: 0 16px; }
            .hero-banner { padding: 24px; }
            .registry-header { padding: 24px 0 20px; }
            .section { margin-bottom: 30px; }
        }

        /* Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--void); }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--surface-3); border-radius: 4px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--gold-dim); }

        /* Selection */
        ::selection { background: var(--gold-glow); color: var(--gold-bright); }

<style>
.serif{font-family:'Crimson Text',serif;}
.display{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

        :root {
            --void: #050508;
            --ink: #0a0a0f;
            --surface: #111118;
            --surface-2: #1a1a24;
            --surface-3: #222230;
            --gold: #c9a84c;
            --gold-dim: #8a7a3a;
            --gold-bright: #e8d78a;
            --gold-glow: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15);
            --crimson: #8b2e2e;
            --crimson-glow: rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.2);
            --text: #d0d0d8;
            --text-dim: #6a6a78;
            --text-bright: #f0f0f5;
            --accent: #4a9eff;
            --accent-dim: #2a5a8a;
            --grid: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.06);
            --border: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.12);
            --border-hover: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.3);
            --success: #4a9e6a;
            --warning: #c9a84c;
            --danger: #c94a4a;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            background: var(--void);
            color: var(--text);
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Background Grid */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* Ambient Glow */
        .ambient-glow {
            position: fixed;
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
            top: -200px;
            right: -200px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            animation: pulse-glow 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-glow {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1.1); }
        }

        /* Container */
        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 24px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* Header */
        .registry-header {
            padding: 40px 0 30px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .header-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-start;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .registry-brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .registry-logo {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border: 2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--surface);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--gold-glow);
        }

        .registry-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .registry-subtitle {
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .header-meta {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .meta-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .meta-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .meta-value {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        .status-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .status-confirmed {
            background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.15);
            color: var(--success);
            border: 1px solid rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.3);
        }

        .status-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: currentColor;
            animation: blink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes blink {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.3; }
        }

        /* Navigation Breadcrumb */
        .breadcrumb {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .breadcrumb a {
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }

        .breadcrumb a:hover {
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        .breadcrumb-sep {
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .breadcrumb-current {
            color: var(--text);
        }

        /* Section Styles */
        .section {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }

        .section-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            padding-bottom: 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .section-number {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold);
            min-width: 32px;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        .section-line {
            flex: 1;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border), transparent);
        }

        /* Hero Banner */
        .hero-banner {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface) 0%, var(--ink) 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 40px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero-banner::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-dim), var(--gold));
            animation: shimmer 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% { background-position: -200% 0; }
            100% { background-position: 200% 0; }
        }

        .hero-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 40px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .hero-left {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .iso-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 6px 16px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .iso-badge .icon {
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .hero-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            text-shadow: 0 0 40px var(--gold-glow);
        }

        .hero-title .arrow {
            color: var(--gold);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .hero-subtitle {
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .hero-claim {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            padding: 16px 20px;
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .hero-right {
            position: relative;
        }

        .equation-card {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;

        .equation-card::after {

            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), transparent, var(--gold-dim));
            -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);

            mask-composite: exclude;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.5;

        .eq-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;

            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;

        }

        .equation {

            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--gold-bright);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .equation .var {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .equation .op {
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .eq-meta {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 24px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);

        .eq-meta span {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .eq-meta .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--gold);
        }

        /* Cross-Genesis Table */
        .cross-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin: 30px 0;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .cross-table th {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            padding: 16px 20px;
            text-align: left;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold);
        }

        .cross-table td {
            padding: 18px 20px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            vertical-align: top;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .cross-table tr:hover td {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            transition: background 0.3s;
        }

        .cross-table .verse-ref {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);

        .cross-table .arrow-cell {
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--gold);

            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 28px;

            align-items: center;

        .test-card.pass .test-icon { background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.2); color: var(--success); }
        .test-card.fail .test-icon { background: rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.2); color: var(--danger); }
        .test-card.partial .test-icon { background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.2); color: var(--warning); }

        .test-name {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .test-desc {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .test-result {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .result-pass { background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.15); color: var(--success); }
        .result-fail { background: rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.15); color: var(--danger); }
        .result-partial { background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15); color: var(--warning); }

        /* Classification Panel */
        .class-panel {

        .class-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .class-item {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 20px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);

        .class-item .class-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;

        }

        .class-item .class-value {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;

        .evidence-chip:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold-bright);
        }

        .evidence-chip .chip-icon {
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Laws Invoked */
        .laws-grid {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            margin: 20px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .law-badge {
            display: inline-flex;

        .law-badge .law-num {

        /* Quote Block */
        .quote-block {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);

            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            margin: 24px 0;

            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.8;
            position: relative;
        }

        .quote-block::before {
            content: '\201C';
            position: absolute;
            top: 8px;
            left: 12px;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 48px;
            color: var(--gold);
            opacity: 0.2;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .quote-block p {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .quote-attribution {
            margin-top: 12px;
            font-style: normal;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
        }

        /* Related ISOs */
        .related-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .related-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;

            text-decoration: none;

            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: block;

        .related-card:hover {

        .related-card .rel-id {

            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .related-card .rel-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;

        .related-card .rel-level {

        /* Footer */
        .registry-footer {

            text-align: center;
        }

        .footer-brand {

            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .footer-meta {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);

        .footer-seal {
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .domain-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .tests-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .class-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .related-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .hero-title { font-size: 24px; }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {

            .section { margin-bottom: 30px; }

        /* Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--gold-dim); }

        /* Selection */

<style>
.serif{font-family:'Crimson Text',serif;}
.display{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

        :root {
            --void: #050508;
            --ink: #0a0a0f;
            --surface: #111118;
            --surface-2: #1a1a24;
            --surface-3: #222230;
            --gold: #c9a84c;
            --gold-dim: #8a7a3a;
            --gold-bright: #e8d78a;
            --gold-glow: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15);
            --crimson: #8b2e2e;
            --crimson-glow: rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.2);
            --text: #d0d0d8;
            --text-dim: #6a6a78;
            --text-bright: #f0f0f5;
            --accent: #4a9eff;
            --accent-dim: #2a5a8a;
            --grid: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.06);
            --border: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.12);
            --border-hover: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.3);
            --success: #4a9e6a;
            --warning: #c9a84c;
            --danger: #c94a4a;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            background: var(--void);
            color: var(--text);
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Background Grid */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* Ambient Glow */
        .ambient-glow {
            position: fixed;
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
            top: -200px;
            right: -200px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            animation: pulse-glow 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-glow {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1.1); }
        }

        /* Container */
        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 24px;

            z-index: 1;

            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--surface);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--gold-glow);

        .registry-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .registry-subtitle {
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .header-meta {

        .meta-row {

            justify-content: flex-end;

        }

        .meta-label {

            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .meta-value {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        .status-badge {
            display: inline-flex;

            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 4px;

            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;

        .status-confirmed {
            background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.15);
            color: var(--success);

        }

        .status-candidate {
            background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15);
            color: var(--warning);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.3);
        }

        .status-pending {
            background: rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.15);
            color: var(--danger);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.3);
        }

        .status-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: currentColor;
            animation: blink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes blink {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.3; }
        }

        /* Navigation Breadcrumb */
        .breadcrumb {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .breadcrumb a {
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }

        .breadcrumb a:hover {
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        .breadcrumb-sep {
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .breadcrumb-current {
            color: var(--text);
        }

        /* Section Styles */
        .section {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }

        .section-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            padding-bottom: 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .section-number {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold);
            min-width: 32px;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 18px;

            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        .section-line {
            flex: 1;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border), transparent);
        }

        /* Hero Banner */
        .hero-banner {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface) 0%, var(--ink) 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 40px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero-banner::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-dim), var(--gold));
            animation: shimmer 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% { background-position: -200% 0; }
            100% { background-position: 200% 0; }
        }

        .hero-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 40px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .hero-left {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .iso-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 6px 16px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .iso-badge .icon {
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .hero-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 800;

        .hero-subtitle {

        .hero-claim {

        .eq-meta {

        /* Cross-Genesis Table */
        .cross-table {
            width: 100%;

            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .cross-table th {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            padding: 16px 20px;
            text-align: left;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;

        /* Mapping Section */
        .mapping-flow {

        .mapping-node {

        .mapping-node .node-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;

            text-transform: uppercase;

        .mapping-node .node-value {

        /* Tests Grid */
        .tests-grid {

        }

        .test-card {

        .test-icon {

        .test-card.pass .test-icon { background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.2); color: var(--success); }
        .test-card.fail .test-icon { background: rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.2); color: var(--danger); }
        .test-card.partial .test-icon { background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.2); color: var(--warning); }

        .test-name {

        /* Classification Panel */
        .class-panel {

            letter-spacing: 2px;

        }

        .class-item .class-value {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;

        }

        .class-item .class-detail {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        /* Evidence Bar */
        .evidence-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;

        }

        .evidence-chip .chip-icon {

        /* Laws Invoked */
        .laws-grid {
            display: flex;

        .law-badge {

        .falsification-box {

        }

        .falsification-box .fals-title {

            color: var(--danger);
            text-transform: uppercase;

            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;

        .falsification-box .fals-content {

        .triad-card {

            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 24px;

        .triad-card:hover {

            box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            transform: translateY(-2px);

        .triad-card .triad-symbol {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 28px;
            color: var(--gold-bright);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .triad-card .triad-physics {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .triad-card .triad-theology {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;

            text-transform: uppercase;

            text-transform: uppercase;

        }

        .footer-meta {

            color: var(--text-dim);

        .footer-seal {

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

<style>
.serif{font-family:'Crimson Text',serif;}
.display{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;}

        :root {

        * {

            min-height: 100vh;

        /* Background Grid */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;

            background-image:
                linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),

            background-size: 60px 60px;

        .ambient-glow {

            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
            top: -200px;
            right: -200px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            animation: pulse-glow 8s ease-in-out infinite;

        .breadcrumb-current {
