            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .hero-claim {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            padding: 16px 20px;
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .hero-right {
            position: relative;
        }

        .equation-card {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 28px;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .equation-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: -1px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), transparent, var(--gold-dim));
            -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
            -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
            mask-composite: exclude;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        .eq-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .equation {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--gold-bright);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .equation .var {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .equation .op {
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .eq-meta {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 24px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .eq-meta span {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .eq-meta .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--gold);
        }

        /* Data Table */
        .data-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin: 24px 0;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .data-table th {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            padding: 14px 16px;
            text-align: left;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold);
        }

        .data-table td {
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            vertical-align: top;
            line-height: 1.5;
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .data-table tr:hover td {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            transition: background 0.3s;
        }

        .data-table .regime-header td {
            background: var(--surface-3);
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--gold-bright);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gold-dim);
        }

        .data-table .anomaly {
            color: var(--warning);
        }

        .data-table .note {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        /* Cross-Genesis Table */
        .cross-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin: 30px 0;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .cross-table th {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            padding: 16px 20px;
            text-align: left;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold);
        }

        .cross-table td {
            padding: 18px 20px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            vertical-align: top;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .cross-table tr:hover td {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            transition: background 0.3s;
        }

        .cross-table .arrow-cell {
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--gold);
            font-size: 18px;
            width: 60px;
        }

        /* Domain Cards */
        .domain-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 24px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .domain-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 28px;
            position: relative;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
        }

        .domain-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .domain-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 4px;
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px;
        }

        .domain-a::before { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-dim)); }
        .domain-b::before { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-dim)); }

        .domain-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .domain-icon {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .domain-a .domain-icon { background: rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.15); }
        .domain-b .domain-icon { background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15); }

        .domain-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .domain-name {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .domain-desc {
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.7;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Mapping Section */
        .mapping-flow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 30px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .mapping-node {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 20px 28px;
            text-align: center;
            min-width: 200px;
        }

        .mapping-node .node-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .mapping-node .node-value {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .mapping-arrow {
            font-size: 24px;
            color: var(--gold);
            animation: pulse-arrow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-arrow {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: translateX(0); }
            50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(4px); }
        }

        /* Tests Grid */
        .tests-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .test-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 24px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .test-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
        }

        .test-card.pass {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--success);
        }

        .test-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .test-icon {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .test-card.pass .test-icon { background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.2); color: var(--success); }

        .test-name {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .test-desc {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .test-result {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .result-pass { background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.15); color: var(--success); }

        /* Classification Panel */
        .class-panel {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface) 0%, var(--ink) 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 32px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .class-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .class-item {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 20px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .class-item .class-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .class-item .class-value {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .class-item .class-detail {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        /* Evidence Bar */
        .evidence-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            margin: 24px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .evidence-chip {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text);
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .evidence-chip:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold-bright);
        }

        .evidence-chip .chip-icon {
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Laws Invoked */
        .laws-grid {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            margin: 20px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .law-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface-2), var(--surface-3));
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .law-badge:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--gold-glow);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .law-badge .law-num {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold-bright);
        }

        /* Falsification Box */
        .falsification-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.1), rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.3);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 24px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--danger);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-content {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-content strong {
            color: var(--danger);
        }

        /* Quote Block */
        .quote-block {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            padding: 20px 24px;
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            margin: 24px 0;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.8;
            position: relative;
        }

        .quote-block::before {
            content: '\201C';
            position: absolute;
            top: 8px;
            left: 12px;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 48px;
            color: var(--gold);
            opacity: 0.2;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .quote-block p {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .quote-attribution {
            margin-top: 12px;
            font-style: normal;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
        }

        /* Convergence Cards */
        .convergence-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .convergence-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 24px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
        }

        .convergence-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
            border-left-color: var(--gold-bright);
        }

        .convergence-num {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .convergence-label {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .convergence-desc {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .convergence-value {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--gold-bright);
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        /* Related ISOs */
        .related-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .related-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 20px;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: block;
        }

        .related-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
            background: var(--surface-2);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .related-card .rel-id {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .related-card .rel-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .related-card .rel-level {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* Footer */
        .registry-footer {
            margin-top: 60px;
            padding: 40px 0;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .footer-brand {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .footer-meta {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .footer-seal {
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .domain-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .tests-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .class-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .related-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .convergence-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .hero-title { font-size: 24px; }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .container { padding: 0 16px; }
            .hero-banner { padding: 24px; }
            .registry-header { padding: 24px 0 20px; }
            .section { margin-bottom: 30px; }
        }

        /* Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--void); }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--surface-3); border-radius: 4px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--gold-dim); }

        /* Selection */
        ::selection { background: var(--gold-glow); color: var(--gold-bright); }

<style>
.serif{font-family:'Crimson Text',serif;}
.display{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

        :root {
            --void: #050508;
            --ink: #0a0a0f;
            --surface: #111118;
            --surface-2: #1a1a24;
            --surface-3: #222230;
            --gold: #c9a84c;
            --gold-dim: #8a7a3a;
            --gold-bright: #e8d78a;
            --gold-glow: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15);
            --crimson: #8b2e2e;
            --crimson-glow: rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.2);
            --text: #d0d0d8;
            --text-dim: #6a6a78;
            --text-bright: #f0f0f5;
            --accent: #4a9eff;
            --accent-dim: #2a5a8a;
            --grid: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.06);
            --border: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.12);
            --border-hover: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.3);
            --success: #4a9e6a;
            --warning: #c9a84c;
            --danger: #c94a4a;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            background: var(--void);
            color: var(--text);
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Background Grid */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* Ambient Glow */
        .ambient-glow {
            position: fixed;
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
            top: -200px;
            right: -200px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            animation: pulse-glow 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-glow {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1.1); }
        }

        /* Container */
        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 24px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* Header */
        .registry-header {
            padding: 40px 0 30px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .header-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-start;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .registry-brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .registry-logo {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border: 2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--surface);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--gold-glow);
        }

        .registry-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .registry-subtitle {
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .header-meta {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .meta-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .meta-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .meta-value {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        .status-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .status-confirmed {
            background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.15);
            color: var(--success);
            border: 1px solid rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.3);
        }

        .status-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: currentColor;
            animation: blink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes blink {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.3; }
        }

        /* Navigation Breadcrumb */
        .breadcrumb {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-dim);

            --accent-dim: #2a5a8a;
            --grid: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.06);
            --border: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.12);
            --border-hover: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.3);
            --success: #4a9e6a;
            --warning: #c9a84c;
            --danger: #c94a4a;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            background: var(--void);
            color: var(--text);
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Background Grid */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* Ambient Glow */
        .ambient-glow {
            position: fixed;
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
            top: -200px;
            right: -200px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            animation: pulse-glow 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-glow {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1.1); }
        }

        /* Container */
        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 24px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* Header */
        .registry-header {
            padding: 40px 0 30px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .header-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-start;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .registry-brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .registry-logo {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border: 2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--surface);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--gold-glow);
        }

        .registry-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .registry-subtitle {
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .header-meta {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .meta-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .meta-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .meta-value {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        .status-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .status-confirmed {
            background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.15);
            color: var(--success);
            border: 1px solid rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.3);
        }

        .status-candidate {
            background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15);
            color: var(--warning);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.3);
        }

        .status-pending {
            background: rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.15);
            color: var(--danger);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.3);
        }

        .status-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: currentColor;
            animation: blink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes blink {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.3; }
        }

        /* Navigation Breadcrumb */
        .breadcrumb {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .breadcrumb a {
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }

        .breadcrumb a:hover {
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        .breadcrumb-sep {
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .breadcrumb-current {
            color: var(--text);
        }

        /* Section Styles */
        .section {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }

        .section-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            padding-bottom: 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .section-number {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold);
            min-width: 32px;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        .section-line {
            flex: 1;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border), transparent);
        }

        /* Hero Banner */
        .hero-banner {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface) 0%, var(--ink) 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 40px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero-banner::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-dim), var(--gold));
            animation: shimmer 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% { background-position: -200% 0; }
            100% { background-position: 200% 0; }
        }

        .hero-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 40px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .hero-left {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .iso-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 6px 16px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .iso-badge .icon {
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .hero-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            text-shadow: 0 0 40px var(--gold-glow);
        }

        .hero-title .arrow {
            color: var(--gold);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .hero-subtitle {
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .hero-claim {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            padding: 16px 20px;
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .hero-right {
            position: relative;
        }

        .equation-card {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 28px;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .equation-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: -1px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), transparent, var(--gold-dim));
            -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
            -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
            mask-composite: exclude;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        .eq-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .equation {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--gold-bright);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .equation .var {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .equation .op {
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .eq-meta {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 24px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .eq-meta span {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .eq-meta .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--gold);
        }

        /* Cross-Genesis Table */
        .cross-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin: 30px 0;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .cross-table th {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            padding: 16px 20px;
            text-align: left;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold);
        }

        .cross-table td {
            padding: 18px 20px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            vertical-align: top;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .cross-table tr:hover td {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            transition: background 0.3s;
        }

        .cross-table .verse-ref {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            display: block;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .cross-table .arrow-cell {
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--gold);
            font-size: 18px;
            width: 60px;
        }

        /* Domain Cards */
        .domain-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 24px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .domain-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 28px;
            position: relative;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
        }

        .domain-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .domain-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 4px;
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px;
        }

        .domain-a::before { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-dim)); }
        .domain-b::before { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-dim)); }

        .domain-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .domain-icon {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .domain-a .domain-icon { background: rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.15); }
        .domain-b .domain-icon { background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15); }

        .domain-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .domain-name {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .domain-desc {
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.7;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Mapping Section */
        .mapping-flow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 30px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .mapping-node {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 20px 28px;
            text-align: center;
            min-width: 200px;
        }

        .mapping-node .node-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .mapping-node .node-value {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .mapping-arrow {
            font-size: 24px;
            color: var(--gold);
            animation: pulse-arrow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-arrow {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: translateX(0); }
            50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(4px); }
        }

        .mapping-arrow.reverse {
            animation: pulse-arrow-reverse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-arrow-reverse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: translateX(0); }
            50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-4px); }
        }

        /* Tests Grid */
        .tests-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .test-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 24px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .test-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
        }

        .test-card.pass {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--success);
        }

        .test-card.fail {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--danger);
        }

        .test-card.partial {
            border-left: 3px solid var(--warning);
        }

        .test-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .test-icon {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .test-card.pass .test-icon { background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.2); color: var(--success); }
        .test-card.fail .test-icon { background: rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.2); color: var(--danger); }
        .test-card.partial .test-icon { background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.2); color: var(--warning); }

        .test-name {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .test-desc {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .test-result {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .result-pass { background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.15); color: var(--success); }
        .result-fail { background: rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.15); color: var(--danger); }
        .result-partial { background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15); color: var(--warning); }

        /* Classification Panel */
        .class-panel {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface) 0%, var(--ink) 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 32px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .class-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 24px;
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .class-item {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 20px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .class-item .class-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .class-item .class-value {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
        }

        .class-item .class-detail {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        /* Evidence Bar */
        .evidence-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            margin: 24px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .evidence-chip {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text);
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .evidence-chip:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold-bright);
        }

        .evidence-chip .chip-icon {
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Laws Invoked */
        .laws-grid {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            margin: 20px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .law-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface-2), var(--surface-3));
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .law-badge:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--gold-glow);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .law-badge .law-num {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold-bright);
        }

        /* Falsification Box */
        .falsification-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.1), rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.3);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 24px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--danger);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-content {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-content strong {
            color: var(--danger);
        }

        /* Quote Block */
        .quote-block {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            padding: 20px 24px;
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            margin: 24px 0;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.8;
            position: relative;
        }

        .quote-block::before {
            content: '\201C';
            position: absolute;
            top: 8px;
            left: 12px;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 48px;
            color: var(--gold);
            opacity: 0.2;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .quote-block p {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .quote-attribution {
            margin-top: 12px;
            font-style: normal;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
        }

        /* Related ISOs */
        .related-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .related-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 20px;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: block;
        }

        .related-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
            background: var(--surface-2);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .related-card .rel-id {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .related-card .rel-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .related-card .rel-level {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* Footer */
        .registry-footer {
            margin-top: 60px;
            padding: 40px 0;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .footer-brand {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .footer-meta {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .footer-seal {
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .domain-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .tests-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .class-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

<style>
.serif{font-family:'Crimson Text',serif;}
.display{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

        :root {
            --void: #050508;
            --ink: #0a0a0f;
            --surface: #111118;
            --surface-2: #1a1a24;
            --surface-3: #222230;
            --gold: #c9a84c;
            --gold-dim: #8a7a3a;
            --gold-bright: #e8d78a;
            --gold-glow: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15);
            --crimson: #8b2e2e;
            --crimson-glow: rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.2);
            --text: #d0d0d8;
            --text-dim: #6a6a78;
            --text-bright: #f0f0f5;
            --accent: #4a9eff;
            --accent-dim: #2a5a8a;
            --grid: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.06);
            --border: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.12);
            --border-hover: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.3);
            --success: #4a9e6a;
            --warning: #c9a84c;
            --danger: #c94a4a;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            background: var(--void);
            color: var(--text);
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* Background Grid */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* Ambient Glow */
        .ambient-glow {
            position: fixed;
            width: 600px;
            height: 600px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold-glow) 0%, transparent 70%);
            top: -200px;
            right: -200px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            animation: pulse-glow 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-glow {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1.1); }
        }

        /* Container */
        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 24px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* Header */
        .registry-header {
            padding: 40px 0 30px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            margin-bottom: 40px;
        }

        .header-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-start;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .registry-brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .registry-logo {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border: 2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--surface);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--gold-glow);
        }

        .registry-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .registry-subtitle {
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .header-meta {
            text-align: right;
        }

        .meta-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .meta-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .meta-value {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        .status-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .status-confirmed {
            background: rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.15);
            color: var(--success);
            border: 1px solid rgba(74, 158, 106, 0.3);

        .status-pending {

            color: var(--danger);
            border: 1px solid rgba(201, 74, 74, 0.3);
        }

        .status-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: currentColor;
            animation: blink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes blink {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.3; }
        }

        /* Navigation Breadcrumb */
        .breadcrumb {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .breadcrumb a {
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: color 0.3s;
        }

        .breadcrumb a:hover {
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        .breadcrumb-sep {
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .breadcrumb-current {
            color: var(--text);
        }

        /* Section Styles */
        .section {
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }

        .section-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            padding-bottom: 12px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

        .section-number {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold);
            min-width: 32px;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        .section-line {
            flex: 1;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border), transparent);
        }

        /* Hero Banner */
        .hero-banner {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface) 0%, var(--ink) 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 40px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero-banner::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-dim), var(--gold));
            animation: shimmer 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% { background-position: -200% 0; }
            100% { background-position: 200% 0; }
        }

        .hero-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 40px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .hero-left {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .iso-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 6px 16px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .iso-badge .icon {
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .hero-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            text-shadow: 0 0 40px var(--gold-glow);
        }

        .hero-title .arrow {
            color: var(--gold);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .hero-subtitle {
            font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .hero-claim {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            padding: 16px 20px;
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;

        .hero-right {

        .equation-card {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 28px;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;

        .equation-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: -1px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), transparent, var(--gold-dim));
            -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
            -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
            mask-composite: exclude;
            pointer-events: none;

        .eq-label {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;

        .equation {

        .eq-meta {

        .eq-meta .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--gold);

        /* Cross-Genesis Table */
        .cross-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin: 30px 0;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .cross-table th {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            padding: 16px 20px;
            text-align: left;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;

            color: var(--gold);
            text-transform: uppercase;

        .cross-table td {

            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

        .cross-table tr:hover td {

        .cross-table .verse-ref {

        .cross-table .arrow-cell {

        /* Domain Cards */
        .domain-grid {

            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;

        .domain-name {

        .mapping-flow {

        /* Tests Grid */

        .evidence-bar {

            gap: 16px;

        .evidence-chip {
            display: inline-flex;

            gap: 8px;

            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);

            color: var(--gold-bright);

        /* Falsification Box */
        .falsification-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.1), rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.3);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 24px;
            margin: 24px 0;

            align-items: center;

            line-height: 1.7;

            color: var(--danger);

            background: var(--surface-2);

            margin: 24px 0;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.8;

        }

            margin-top: 12px;
            font-style: normal;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
        }

        /* Related ISOs */
        .related-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .related-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 20px;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: block;

<style>
.serif{font-family:'Crimson Text',serif;}
.display{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;}

        :root {

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;

        body::before {

        }

        .evidence-chip {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text);
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .evidence-chip:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold-bright);
        }

        .evidence-chip .chip-icon {
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* Laws Invoked */
        .laws-grid {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            margin: 20px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .law-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface-2), var(--surface-3));
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .law-badge:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--gold-glow);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .law-badge .law-num {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--gold-bright);
        }

        /* Falsification Box */
        .falsification-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.1), rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(139, 46, 46, 0.3);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 24px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--danger);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-content {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .falsification-box .fals-content strong {
            color: var(--danger);
        }

        /* Quote Block */
        .quote-block {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            padding: 20px 24px;
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            margin: 24px 0;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            line-height: 1.8;
            position: relative;
        }

        .quote-block::before {
            content: '\201C';
            position: absolute;
            top: 8px;
            left: 12px;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 48px;
            color: var(--gold);
            opacity: 0.2;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .quote-block p {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .quote-attribution {
            margin-top: 12px;
            font-style: normal;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
        }

        /* Related ISOs */
        .related-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
            margin: 24px 0;
        }

        .related-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 20px;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            display: block;
        }

        .related-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-hover);
            background: var(--surface-2);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .related-card .rel-id {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .related-card .rel-title {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-bright);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .related-card .rel-level {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* Commandment Table */
        .cmd-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin: 24px 0;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .cmd-table th {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            padding: 14px 20px;
            text-align: left;
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold);
        }

        .cmd-table td {
            padding: 14px 20px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            vertical-align: top;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .cmd-table tr:hover td {
            background: var(--surface-2);
            transition: background 0.3s;
        }

        .cmd-table .cmd-num {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--gold);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-align: center;
            width: 40px;
        }

        /* Footer */
        .registry-footer {
            margin-top: 60px;
            padding: 40px 0;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .footer-brand {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--gold-dim);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .footer-meta {
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .footer-seal {
            margin-top: 20px;
            font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .domain-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .tests-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .class-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .related-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
            .hero-title { font-size: 24px; }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .container { padding: 0 16px; }
            .hero-banner { padding: 24px; }
            .registry-header { padding: 24px 0 20px; }
            .section { margin-bottom: 30px; }
            .related-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        /* Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--void); }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--surface-3); border-radius: 4px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--gold-dim); }

        /* Selection */
        ::selection { background: var(--gold-glow); color: var(--gold-bright); }
