.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:1.2rem}





/* Center: Series Home + Site Home */


.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:140px}


.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;transition:all .25s;text-align:center;background:var(--surface2)}


.tp-bignav-series:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(212,175,55,.12);background:var(--surface)}


.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em}


.tp-bignav-home:hover{color:var(--gold)}





@media(max-width:650px){


  .tp-bignav-row{flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}


  .tp-bignav-center{flex-direction:row;gap:1rem;padding:.6rem 0;order:-1;justify-content:center}


  .tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{padding:1.2rem 1rem}


  .tp-bignav-title{font-size:1rem}


}





/* ═══════ FINAL AUDIT ═══════ */


.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}


.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}


.tp-audit-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:60%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.4}


.tp-audit-head{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem}


.tp-audit-intro{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 auto .8rem;max-width:640px;line-height:1.6}


.tp-audit-covenant{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0 auto 2rem;max-width:640px;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;border-left:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);border-right:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);background:rgba(212,175,55,.04);line-height:1.6;font-style:italic}


.tp-audit-covenant b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;font-style:normal}


.tp-audit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;text-align:left}


@media(max-width:700px){.tp-audit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}


.tp-audit-col{padding:1.2rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}


.tp-audit-col::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(255,255,255,.03),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}


.tp-audit-col:hover::before{opacity:1}


.tp-audit-col:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}


.tp-audit-col h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.8rem}


.tp-audit-col ul{list-style:none;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.55}


.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}

.tp-col-over{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}.tp-col-over h4{color:var(--gold)}

/* ═══════ GOLD DIVIDER ═══════ */


.tp-gold-divider{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}

.tp-subdomains{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem}

.tp-sub-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:1.2rem}

@media(max-width:900px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}


@media(max-width:550px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}


.tp-sub-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:1.3rem .8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;transition:all .35s;text-align:center;min-height:100px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}


.tp-sub-card i{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .35s}


.tp-sub-card h4{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);margin:0;line-height:1.25;transition:color .3s}


.tp-sub-card p{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0;transition:color .3s}

.tp-sub-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}


.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}


.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}


.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}


.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}





/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */


.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}


.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}


.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}


.tp-series-strip a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}


.tp-series-strip a.soon{opacity:.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}


.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}





/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */


.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}

/* ═══════ 15 + 15 = 100 (THE DOOR) ═══════ */


.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}


.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-gold 4s ease-in-out infinite}

.tp-door-sub{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .3s;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.5}

.tp-door-mark{display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:1.2rem auto 0;opacity:.4}





/* ═══════ SCROLLBAR ═══════ */


::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}


::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}


::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border-2);border-radius:3px}


::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--border-hi)}





/* ═══════ SELECTION ═══════ */


::selection{background:rgba(212,175,55,.2);color:var(--text)}

.tp-article code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85rem;background:var(--surface2);padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:3px;color:var(--gold)}


.tp-article pre{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:1rem;overflow-x:auto;margin:1.5rem 0}

/* ═══════ BIG PREV / NEXT NAV ═══════ */

.tp-bignav-row{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:1rem}


.tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;transition:all .3s;min-height:90px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}


.tp-bignav-prev{justify-content:flex-start}


.tp-bignav-next{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}


.tp-bignav-prev::before,.tp-bignav-next::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--hover-x,50%) var(--hover-y,50%),rgba(212,175,55,.06),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}


.tp-bignav-prev:hover::before,.tp-bignav-next:hover::before{opacity:1}


.tp-bignav-prev:hover,.tp-bignav-next:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}


.tp-bignav-arrow{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .3s;flex-shrink:0}


.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-arrow,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-arrow{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.1)}


.tp-bignav-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem}


.tp-bignav-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}


.tp-bignav-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;transition:color .2s}


.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-title,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-title{color:var(--gold)}


.tp-bignav-prev .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-right:1.2rem}


.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:1.2rem}





/* Center: Series Home + Site Home */


.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:140px}


.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;transition:all .25s;text-align:center;background:var(--surface2)}


.tp-bignav-series:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(212,175,55,.12);background:var(--surface)}


.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em}

@media(max-width:650px){


  .tp-bignav-row{flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}

  .tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{padding:1.2rem 1rem}


  .tp-bignav-title{font-size:1rem}


}





/* ═══════ FINAL AUDIT ═══════ */

.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}


.tp-audit-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:60%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.4}

.tp-col-right{border-color:rgba(59,179,154,.2)}.tp-col-right h4{color:var(--teal)}

.tp-col-over{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}.tp-col-over h4{color:var(--gold)}

/* ═══════ GOLD DIVIDER ═══════ */


.tp-gold-divider{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}

/* ═══════ SUBDOMAIN GRID ═══════ */


.tp-subdomains{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem}


.tp-sub-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:.4rem}

.tp-sub-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:1.3rem .8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;transition:all .35s;text-align:center;min-height:100px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}


.tp-sub-card i{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .35s}

.tp-sub-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,rgba(212,175,55,.1),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s}


.tp-sub-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}


.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}


.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}


.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}


.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}





/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */


.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}


.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}


.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}


.tp-series-strip a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}


.tp-series-strip a.soon{opacity:.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}


.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}





/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */


.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}


.tp-bottom-eq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.6rem;letter-spacing:.05em}

.tp-bottom-vow{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.82rem;margin-top:.8rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem}





/* ═══════ 15 + 15 = 100 (THE DOOR) ═══════ */


.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}


.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-gold 4s ease-in-out infinite}

.tp-door-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:.5rem;cursor:default;transition:all .5s;position:relative}


.tp-door-num:hover{text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--gold-glow),0 0 60px rgba(212,175,55,.2);letter-spacing:.22em}


.tp-door-sub{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .3s;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.5}

.tp-door-mark{display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:1.2rem auto 0;opacity:.4}





/* ═══════ SCROLLBAR ═══════ */


::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}

/* ═══════ SELECTION ═══════ */

.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:140px}


.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;transition:all .25s;text-align:center;background:var(--surface2)}


.tp-bignav-series:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(212,175,55,.12);background:var(--surface)}


.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em}

@media(max-width:650px){

  .tp-bignav-title{font-size:1rem}


}

.tp-audit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;text-align:left}

.tp-subdomains{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem}

.tp-sub-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:1.3rem .8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;transition:all .35s;text-align:center;min-height:100px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}

.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}


.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}


.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}


.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}





/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */


.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}


.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}


.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}

.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}





/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */


.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}

.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}


.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-gold 4s ease-in-out infinite}

/* ═══════ COMPONENT:hero:hero-series-packet ═══════ */

.sp-hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:15%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:800px;height:400px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(212,175,55,.05) 0%,transparent 65%);pointer-events:none}
.sp-hero-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;position:relative}

/* Grade badge */
.sp-grade-card{flex:0 0 auto;padding:1.5rem 2rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;text-align:center;min-width:140px}
.sp-grade-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:.4rem}

/* ═══════ COMPONENT:card:article-cards ═══════ */
.card-grid{display:grid;gap:.6rem}
.card-grid-1{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.card-grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr))}
.sp-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:1rem 1.1rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;transition:all .2s}

/* ═══════ COMPONENT:section:tables ═══════ */
.sp-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.sp-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.83rem;min-width:550px}
.sp-table th{text-align:left;padding:.6rem .7rem;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-weight:500}
.sp-table td{padding:.55rem .7rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-2);color:var(--text)}
.sp-table tr:hover td{background:var(--surface2)}
.sp-table td:first-child{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold)}
.pe-status{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:.35rem}
.status-pass{background:var(--rung-easy)}
.status-warn{background:var(--rung-med)}
.status-fail{background:var(--rung-hard)}

/* ═══════ COMPONENT:section:claim-strength ═══════ */
.strength-bar{display:flex;gap:2px;height:6px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:.5rem}
.strength-seg{height:100%}
.strength-seg.strong{background:var(--rung-easy);flex:var(--strong-pct)}
.strength-seg.partial{background:var(--rung-med);flex:var(--partial-pct)}
.strength-seg.weak{background:var(--rung-hard);flex:var(--weak-pct)}

/* ═══════ COMPONENT:section:7qs-summary ═══════ */
.q7-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:.5rem}
.q7-item{padding:.8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold)}
.q7-item-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:.3rem}
.q7-item-text{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.45}

/* ═══════ COMPONENT:section:coverage-matrix ═══════ */
.coverage-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(90px,1fr));gap:.3rem}
.coverage-cell{padding:.6rem .4rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem}
.coverage-cell.covered{border-color:rgba(74,222,128,.3);background:rgba(74,222,128,.06)}
.coverage-cell.partial{border-color:rgba(251,146,60,.3);background:rgba(251,146,60,.06)}
.coverage-cell.uncovered{border-color:var(--border);opacity:.5}
.coverage-cell-law{color:var(--gold);font-size:.55rem;display:block;margin-bottom:.15rem}
.coverage-cell-name{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:.52rem}

/* ═══════ COMPONENT:footer:footer-series-packet ═══════ */
.sp-footer{max-width:var(--max);margin:2.5rem auto 0;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.sp-footer .feq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.sp-footer p{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.75rem;margin:.25rem 0}

@media(max-width:640px){
  .sp-hero-row{flex-direction:column}
  .sp-grade-card{align-self:flex-start}
  .card-grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .q7-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .coverage-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}
  .sp-stats-inner{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .sp-stat{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
}

  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.chain h3 {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 1.35em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #e6e6e6;
  margin: 32px 0 12px;
}

/* Anti-terms */
.anti-block {
  background: rgba(239,68,68,.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.12);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}
.anti-block .anti-label {
  font-size: .7em;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--red);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.anti-block p { font-size: .85em; color: var(--fg2); margin: 0; }

/* Kill condition */
.kill-block {
  background: rgba(167,139,250,.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.12);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}
.kill-block .kill-label {
  font-size: .7em;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--purple);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.kill-block p { font-size: .85em; color: var(--fg2); margin: 0; }

/* Test results */
.test-block {
  background: rgba(34,197,94,.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.15);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}
.test-block .test-label {
  font-size: .7em;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--green);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.test-bar-wrap {
  height: 6px; border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--bg); margin: 8px 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.test-bar-fill {
  height: 100%; border-radius: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green), #4ade80);
}

/* Axiom spine */
.spine {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 32px;
  margin: 24px 0;
}
.spine::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 8px; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), var(--green), var(--purple));
  border-radius: 1px;
}
.spine-item {
  position: relative;
  padding: 8px 0;
  font-size: .9em;
}
.spine-item::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: -28px; top: 14px;
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--gold);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(201,162,39,.4);
}
.spine-item.derived::before { background: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,.4); }

/* Blockquote */
.callout {
  border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
  padding: 16px 20px;
  margin: 24px 0;
  background: var(--gold-glow);
  border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
}
.callout p {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 1.1em;
  color: #e6e6e6;
  font-style: italic;
  margin: 0;
}

/* TOC */
.toc {
  background: var(--bg2);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 24px 28px;
  margin: 40px 0;
}
.toc h3 {
  font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
  font-size: 1.2em;
  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.toc a {
  display: block;
  padding: 6px 0;
  color: var(--fg2);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: .88em;
  transition: color .15s;
}
.toc a:hover { color: var(--gold); }
.toc a .toc-num {
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  color: var(--gold);
  opacity: .5;
  margin-right: 12px;
  font-size: .85em;
}

/* Footer */
.footer {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 48px 24px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
}
.footer p { font-size: .75em; color: var(--fg3); margin: 4px 0; }
.footer .gold { color: var(--gold); }
</style>

</style>

</style>

:root{
  --bg:#080b0f;--bg2:#0d1117;--bg3:#111820;--border:#1e2d3d;

  --blue:#4d9de0;--text:#c8d8e8;--text2:#8aa0b4;--muted:#4a6278;

}

header{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:20px 32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(240,165,0,.04),transparent)}
.logo{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:5px;color:var(--amber);text-transform:uppercase}
.logo span{display:block;color:var(--text2);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:2px}
.nav{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nav a,.btn{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;transition:.15s}
.nav a{border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text2);font-size:12px;padding:8px 14px}
.nav a:hover{border-color:var(--amber);color:var(--amber)}
main{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:64px 24px}
.kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:4px;color:var(--amber);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:18px}
h1{font-family:var(--head);font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.4rem);line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:18px}
.lead{font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--text2);max-width:760px;margin-bottom:28px}
.panel{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:28px;margin:28px 0}
.panel h2{font-family:var(--head);font-size:1.2rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--amber);margin-bottom:14px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:24px}
.card{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:22px}
.card i{color:var(--amber);font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:12px}
.card h3{font-family:var(--head);font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin-bottom:8px}
.card p{color:var(--text2);font-size:1rem}
.actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:28px}
.btn{background:var(--amber);color:#080b0f;border:1px solid var(--amber);padding:13px 18px;font-size:13px}
.btn:hover{background:var(--amber2);border-color:var(--amber2)}
.btn.secondary{background:transparent;color:var(--text2);border-color:var(--border)}
.btn.secondary:hover{color:var(--amber);border-color:var(--amber)}
.note{border-left:3px solid var(--amber);padding-left:16px;color:var(--text2);font-size:1rem}
code{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--amber2)}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:28px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px}

</style>

<style>
:root {
  --bg: #050505;
  --bg-elevated: #0a0a0a;
  --bg-panel: #11100e;
  --ink: #f0e6d3;
  --ink-dim: #b8a88a;
  --ink-faint: #6b5d4d;
  --gold: #d4af37;
  --gold-bright: #f0c659;
  --gold-dim: #8a7a3a;
  --ember: #c9461a;
  --ember-bright: #f06121;
  --accent-blue: #5a8ab8;
  --border: rgba(212,175,55,0.12);
  --border-strong: rgba(212,175,55,0.25);
  --glow-gold: rgba(212,175,55,0.15);
  --font-display: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif;
  --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
  --font-sans: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.site-shell-top, .ftp-topbar, .mtl-reader-bar { display: none !important; }

body::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 8%, rgba(212,175,55,0.04) 0%, transparent 45%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 82% 85%, rgba(201,70,26,0.03) 0%, transparent 45%);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.container {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 5rem 1.5rem 8rem;
}

/* HERO */
.hero {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
}

.hero-kicker {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.34em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ember-bright);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.hero-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(40px, 7vw, 80px);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.05;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.hero-subtitle {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: clamp(15px, 2vw, 18px);
  color: var(--ink-dim);
  max-width: 620px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.hero-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 1.2rem;
  margin-top: 1.8rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

/* STICKY AUDIO PLAYER */
.audio-bar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  background: rgba(5,5,5,0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  margin: 0 -1.5rem 2.5rem;
}

.audio-bar-inner {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.audio-bar-btn {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--gold);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--gold);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 14px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.audio-bar-btn:hover {
  background: var(--gold);
  color: var(--bg);
}

.audio-bar-info {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.audio-bar-chapter {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold-dim);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.audio-bar-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--ink);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.audio-bar-progress {
  flex: 2;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--border);
  border-radius: 2px;
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
}

.audio-bar-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  width: 0%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-bright));
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: width 0.1s linear;
}

.audio-bar-time {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  min-width: 80px;
  text-align: right;
}

.audio-bar-note {
  display: none;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

/* INTRO CARD */
.guide-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(212,175,55,0.12), rgba(212,175,55,0.04) 60%, rgba(201,70,26,0.03)), var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: var(--ink-dim);
}

.guide-card strong {
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.guide-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.guide-actions a {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold);
  text-decoration: none;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.guide-actions a:hover {
  background: var(--gold);
  color: var(--bg);
  border-color: var(--gold);
}

/* TIMELINE */
.timeline {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 24px;
}

.timeline::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 6px;
  top: 8px;
  bottom: 8px;
  width: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--border-strong), var(--border) 50%, var(--border-strong));
}

.act {
  position: relative;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  opacity: 1;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.act-dot {
  position: absolute;
  left: -24px;
  top: 10px;
  width: 13px;
  height: 13px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 2px solid var(--gold-dim);
  transition: all 0.3s;
}

.act.live .act-dot {
  background: var(--gold);
  border-color: var(--gold-bright);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--glow-gold);
}

.act.active .act-dot {
  transform: scale(1.25);
  background: var(--gold-bright);
}

.act-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.act-header:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  background: rgba(17,16,14,0.7);
}

.act.live .act-header {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.act-number {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold-dim);
  min-width: 58px;
}

.act-title {
  flex: 1;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(18px, 3vw, 24px);
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.act.coming-soon .act-title {
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.act-status {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
}

.act.live .act-status {
  color: var(--gold);
  border-color: var(--gold-dim);
}

.act-toggle {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  transition: transform 0.3s;
}

.act.open .act-toggle {
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.act-body {
  max-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: max-height 0.45s ease, opacity 0.3s ease, padding 0.35s ease;
}

.act.open .act-body {
  max-height: 2000px;
  opacity: 1;
  padding: 1.2rem 1rem 2rem;
}

.act-narrative {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(17px, 2.2vw, 21px);
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ink-dim);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.act-narrative a {
  color: var(--gold);
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--gold-dim);
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.act-narrative a:hover {
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  border-bottom-color: var(--gold);
}

.act-narrative a:visited {
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  border-bottom-color: transparent;
}

.act-links-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold-dim);
  margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

.act-links {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
}

.act-link {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(17,16,14,0.5);
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.act-link:hover {
  border-color: var(--gold-dim);
  background: rgba(212,175,55,0.06);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.act-link-type {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;

  --gold:#d4af37; --gold-dim:rgba(212,175,55,.08); --gold-glow:rgba(212,175,55,.3);
  --red:#c94040; --teal:#3bb39a; --blue:#7cc7ff; --purple:#a78bfa; --green:#7fc77f;
  --serif:'Crimson Text',Georgia,serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
  --display:'Oswald','Inter',sans-serif;
  --sans:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --max:1140px; --header-h:48px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--sans);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}

/* ═══════ TOP BAR ═══════ */
.tp-top{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(5,5,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);height:var(--header-h)}
.tp-top-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;height:100%;padding:0 1.2rem;gap:.6rem}
.tp-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:.2rem .4rem .2rem 0;border-radius:4px;transition:background .3s}
.tp-brand-chi{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1;transition:all .3s}
.tp-brand-name{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .3s}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-chi{text-shadow:0 0 14px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-brand:hover .tp-brand-name{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-brand::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-glow),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .4s ease}
.tp-brand:hover::after{width:140px;height:140px;opacity:1}
.tp-div{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--border-2);flex-shrink:0;margin:0 .3rem}

/* Left nav */
.tp-nav-links{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:center}
.tp-nav-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.32rem .55rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-nav-link:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-nav-link.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.08)}
.tp-nav-link i{margin-right:.3rem;font-size:.55rem}
.tp-nav-link::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.15),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .3s}
.tp-nav-link:hover::after{width:60px;height:60px;opacity:1}
.tp-spacer{flex:1}

/* Reading levels */
.tp-levels{display:flex;gap:2px;background:var(--surface2);padding:3px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-level{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-level:hover{color:var(--text)}
.tp-level.active{background:var(--surface3);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.15);border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.2)}
.tp-level::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:0;height:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.2),transparent 70%);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:all .35s}
.tp-level:hover::after{width:80px;height:80px;opacity:1}
.tp-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.35rem .6rem;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border-2);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.7rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.tp-search:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-search kbd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 .3rem;border-radius:2px}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-brand-name{display:none}.tp-search kbd{display:none}.tp-level{font-size:.55rem;padding:.3rem .4rem}.tp-nav-link{font-size:.58rem;padding:.25rem .4rem}}

/* ═══════ CLASSIFICATION BAR ═══════ */
.tp-class{position:fixed;top:var(--header-h);left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(8,8,8,.94);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:.4rem 0}
.tp-class-inner{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}
.tp-class-center{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem}
.tp-class-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-class-bar{display:flex;height:5px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;gap:1px}
.tp-class-seg{transition:flex .4s ease;position:relative}
.tp-class-seg::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-class-bar:hover .tp-class-seg::after{opacity:1}
.tp-class-tags{display:flex;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tp-class-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s}
.tp-class-tag:hover{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-class-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 4px currentColor}
/* Small nav */
.tp-class-nav{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:.25rem .5rem;border-radius:4px;transition:all .15s;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-class-nav:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15)}
@media(max-width:600px){.tp-class-tags{display:none}}

/* ═══════ ARTICLE BODY ═══════ */
.tp-article{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:calc(var(--header-h) + 68px) 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-article h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:400;color:#fff;margin-bottom:.6rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em}

.tp-article h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-weight:400;margin:3rem 0 1rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tp-article h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;margin:2rem 0 .6rem}

.tp-article blockquote{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:1.2rem;margin:1.5rem 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem}

.tp-article code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85rem;background:var(--surface2);padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:3px;color:var(--gold)}
.tp-article pre{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:1rem;overflow-x:auto;margin:1.5rem 0}
.tp-article pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-dim)}

/* ═══════ BIG PREV / NEXT NAV ═══════ */
.tp-bignav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem}
.tp-bignav-row{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:1rem}
.tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;transition:all .3s;min-height:90px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-bignav-prev{justify-content:flex-start}
.tp-bignav-next{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}
.tp-bignav-prev::before,.tp-bignav-next::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--hover-x,50%) var(--hover-y,50%),rgba(212,175,55,.06),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover::before,.tp-bignav-next:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover,.tp-bignav-next:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-bignav-arrow{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .3s;flex-shrink:0}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-arrow,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-arrow{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.1)}
.tp-bignav-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.2rem}
.tp-bignav-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-bignav-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;transition:color .2s}
.tp-bignav-prev:hover .tp-bignav-title,.tp-bignav-next:hover .tp-bignav-title{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-bignav-prev .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-right:1.2rem}
.tp-bignav-next .tp-bignav-arrow{margin-left:1.2rem}

/* Center: Series Home + Site Home */
.tp-bignav-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 .6rem;min-width:140px}
.tp-bignav-series{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim);padding:.5rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;transition:all .25s;text-align:center;background:var(--surface2)}
.tp-bignav-series:hover{color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(212,175,55,.12);background:var(--surface)}
.tp-bignav-home{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .2s;letter-spacing:.1em}
.tp-bignav-home:hover{color:var(--gold)}

@media(max-width:650px){
  .tp-bignav-row{flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}
  .tp-bignav-center{flex-direction:row;gap:1rem;padding:.6rem 0;order:-1;justify-content:center}
  .tp-bignav-prev,.tp-bignav-next{padding:1.2rem 1rem}
  .tp-bignav-title{font-size:1rem}
}

/* ═══════ FINAL AUDIT ═══════ */
.tp-audit{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 2.5rem}
.tp-audit-box{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:2.5rem 2rem;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:60%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.4}
.tp-audit-head{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1rem}
.tp-audit-intro{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 auto .8rem;max-width:640px;line-height:1.6}
.tp-audit-covenant{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0 auto 2rem;max-width:640px;padding:.8rem 1.2rem;border-left:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);border-right:2px solid rgba(212,175,55,.3);background:rgba(212,175,55,.04);line-height:1.6;font-style:italic}
.tp-audit-covenant b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;font-style:normal}
.tp-audit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1rem;text-align:left}
@media(max-width:700px){.tp-audit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.tp-audit-col{padding:1.2rem;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tp-audit-col::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,rgba(255,255,255,.03),transparent 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.tp-audit-col:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-audit-col:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.tp-audit-col h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.tp-audit-col ul{list-style:none;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.55}
.tp-audit-col li{padding:.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.tp-audit-col li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.tp-col-right{border-color:rgba(59,179,154,.2)}.tp-col-right h4{color:var(--teal)}
.tp-col-right:hover{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(59,179,154,.1)}
.tp-col-over{border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}.tp-col-over h4{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-col-over:hover{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-col-wrong{border-color:rgba(201,64,64,.2)}.tp-col-wrong h4{color:var(--red)}
.tp-col-wrong:hover{border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(201,64,64,.1)}

/* ═══════ GOLD DIVIDER ═══════ */
.tp-gold-divider{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}
.tp-gold-divider-line{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(212,175,55,.3),transparent)}

/* ═══════ SUBDOMAIN GRID ═══════ */
.tp-subdomains{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem}
.tp-sub-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.tp-sub-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(212,175,55,.3)}
.tp-sub-kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;color:var(--text-muted);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tp-sub-title{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.05rem;color:#fff;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.tp-sub-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:.7rem}
@media(max-width:900px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:550px){.tp-sub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.tp-sub-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:1.3rem .8rem;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;transition:all .35s;text-align:center;min-height:100px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer}
.tp-sub-card i{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.4;transition:all .35s}
.tp-sub-card h4{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--text);margin:0;line-height:1.25;transition:color .3s}
.tp-sub-card p{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.52rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin:0;transition:color .3s}
.tp-sub-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,rgba(212,175,55,.1),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s}
.tp-sub-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(212,175,55,.12)}
.tp-sub-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.tp-sub-card:hover i{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold-glow)}
.tp-sub-card:hover h4{color:var(--gold)}
.tp-sub-grid:hover .tp-sub-card:not(:hover){opacity:.35;border-color:transparent;transform:scale(.98)}

/* ═══════ SERIES NAV ═══════ */
.tp-series-nav{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem 1.5rem}
.tp-series-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;justify-content:center;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tp-series-strip a{font-family:var(--display);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:.4rem .7rem;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .2s;border:1px solid transparent}
.tp-series-strip a:hover{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.15);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(212,175,55,.1)}
.tp-series-strip a.soon{opacity:.3;cursor:default;pointer-events:none}
.tp-series-strip a.active{color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-dim);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.2)}

/* ═══════ BOTTOM BAR ═══════ */
.tp-bottom{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;text-align:center}
.tp-bottom-eq{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold);opacity:.5;margin-bottom:.6rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
.tp-bottom-copy{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.68rem;margin:.25rem 0}
.tp-bottom-vow{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.82rem;margin-top:.8rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem}

/* ═══════ 15 + 15 = 100 (THE DOOR) ═══════ */
.tp-door{text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem 3.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface)}
.tp-door::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:300px;height:300px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent 70%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;animation:pulse-gold 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse-gold{0%,100%{opacity:.6}50%{opacity:1}}
.tp-door-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;margin-bottom:.5rem;cursor:default;transition:all .5s;position:relative}
.tp-door-num:hover{text-shadow:0 0 30px var(--gold-glow),0 0 60px rgba(212,175,55,.2);letter-spacing:.22em}
.tp-door-sub{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:color .3s;max-width:400px;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.5}
.tp-door:hover .tp-door-sub{color:var(--text-dim)}
.tp-door-mark{display:block;width:40px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);margin:1.2rem auto 0;opacity:.4}

/* ═══════ SCROLLBAR ═══════ */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border-2);border-radius:3px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--border-hi)}

/* ═══════ SELECTION ═══════ */
::selection{background:rgba(212,175,55,.2);color:var(--text)}
</style>

<style>

      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .container {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 2rem;
    }
    p { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
    strong { color: #e6edf3; font-weight: 600; }
    .prose { font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }

    /* ── STICKY HEADER ── */
    .site-header {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: .9rem 0;
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      background: rgba(10,10,10,.96);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      z-index: 100;
    }
    .site-header .container {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .site-brand {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .72rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: .2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .site-brand span { color: var(--gold); }
    .iso-badge {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .7rem;
      color: var(--gold);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-gold);
      padding: .22rem .65rem;
      border-radius: 3px;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
    }

    /* ── HERO ── */
    .hero {
      padding: 5rem 0 4rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-bg-number {
      position: absolute;
      right: -1rem;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(12rem,28vw,26rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gold-faded);
      line-height: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
      user-select: none;
      letter-spacing: -.05em;
    }
    .hero-iso-id {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .8rem;
      color: var(--gold);
      letter-spacing: .3em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .75rem;
    }
    .hero-iso-id::after {
      content: '';
      display: inline-block;
      width: 80px;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), transparent);
    }
    .hero-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2rem,5.5vw,3.8rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .04em;
      color: #fff;
      line-height: 1.08;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: clamp(.85rem,2vw,1.05rem);
      color: var(--gold);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
    }
    .hero-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: .45rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }
    .tag {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .62rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: .14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: .28rem .7rem;
      border-radius: 2px;
      border: 1px solid;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .35rem;
    }
    .tag-gold { color: var(--gold); border-color: var(--border-gold); background: var(--gold-faded); }
    .tag-green { color: var(--success); border-color: rgba(63,185,80,.25); background: rgba(63,185,80,.05); }
    .tag-blue { color: var(--info); border-color: rgba(121,192,255,.25); background: rgba(121,192,255,.05); }
    .tag-purple { color: var(--purple); border-color: rgba(192,132,252,.25); background: rgba(192,132,252,.05); }
    .tag-warn { color: var(--warn); border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.25); background: rgba(245,158,11,.05); }
    .hero-meta {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(145px,1fr));
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      overflow: hidden;
      max-width: 780px;
    }
    .hero-meta-item {
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .hero-meta-label {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .52rem;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin-bottom: .25rem;
    }
    .hero-meta-value {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .82rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
      letter-spacing: .04em;
    }
    .hero-meta-value.gold { color: var(--gold); }
    .hero-meta-value.green { color: var(--success); }
    .hero-meta-value.warn { color: var(--warn); }
    .hero-meta-value.blue { color: var(--info); }
    .hero-meta-value.purple { color: var(--purple); }

    /* ── SECTIONS ── */
    .main-content { padding: 0 0 7rem; }
    .iso-section {
      padding: var(--section-gap) 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .iso-section:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .section-header {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      align-items: start;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }
    .section-num {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: .85;
      color: var(--gold-faded-2);
      letter-spacing: -.03em;
      user-select: none;
      min-width: 100px;
      text-align: right;
      padding-top: .1em;
    }
    .section-title-group { padding-top: .3rem; }
    .section-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(1.3rem,3vw,1.85rem);
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: .5rem;
    }
    .section-divider {
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), rgba(212,175,55,.3) 50%, transparent);
      border-radius: 1px;
      margin-bottom: .5rem;
    }
    .section-subtitle {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .7rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* ── CONTENT BLOCKS ── */
    .claim-block {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
      padding: 1.75rem 2rem;
      border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      font-size: 1.03rem;
      line-height: 1.75;
    }
    .kill-condition {
      background: var(--surface-2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(248,81,73,.25);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--danger);
      padding: 1.25rem 1.75rem;
      border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
    }
    .kill-label {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .65rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: .2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--danger);
      margin-bottom: .5rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .5rem;
    }

    /* ── TABLES ── */
    .iso-table-wrap {
      overflow-x: auto;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
    }
    .iso-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: .875rem;
      min-width: 580px;
    }
    .iso-table thead tr {
      background: var(--surface-2);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-gold);
    }
    .iso-table thead th {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .62rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: .9rem 1.1rem;
      text-align: left;
    }
    .iso-table thead th.col-physics { color: var(--info); }
    .iso-table thead th.col-theology { color: var(--purple); }
    .iso-table thead th.col-moral { color: var(--success); }
    .iso-table thead th.col-property { color: var(--gold); }
    .iso-table thead th.col-label { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .iso-table tbody tr {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: background .12s;
    }
    .iso-table tbody tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .iso-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(212,175,55,.04); }
    .iso-table td {
      padding: .9rem 1.1rem;
      vertical-align: top;
      line-height: 1.58;
    }
    .td-label {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gold);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .07em;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .td-physics { color: var(--info); }
    .td-theology { color: var(--purple); }
    .td-moral { color: var(--success); }
    .td-note { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: .8rem; font-style: italic; display: block; margin-top: .3rem; }

    /* ── EQUATION BLOCKS ── */
    .equation-block {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }
    .equation-block .eq-label {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .58rem;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: .5rem;
    }
    .equation {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--gold);
      line-height: 1.8;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
    }
    .eq-note {
      font-size: .82rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-top: .5rem;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    /* ── INFO CARDS GRID ── */
    .card-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px,1fr));
      gap: 1rem;
    }
    .info-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 1.25rem;
      transition: border-color .2s;
    }
    .info-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-gold); }
    .info-card-label {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .65rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: .18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: .4rem;
    }
    .info-card-value {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gold);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: .3rem;
    }
    .info-card-text {
      font-size: .82rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    /* ── STATUS ── */
    .status-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(175px,1fr));
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
    }
    .status-card {
      padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--surface);
    }
    .status-label {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .52rem;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin-bottom: .35rem;
    }
    .status-value {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: .04em;
    }
    .status-value.green { color: var(--success); }
    .status-value.gold { color: var(--gold); }
    .status-value.blue { color: var(--info); }
    .status-value.warn { color: var(--warn); }
    .status-value.purple { color: var(--purple); }

    /* ── ACCENT BLOCKS ── */
    .accent-block {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
      border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .accent-block.gold { border-left: 3px solid var(--gold); }
    .accent-block.green { border-left: 3px solid var(--success); }
    .accent-block.warn { border-left: 3px solid var(--warn); }
    .accent-block.blue { border-left: 3px solid var(--info); }
    .accent-block.danger { border-left: 3px solid var(--danger); }
    .accent-label {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .63rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: .2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: .4rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .5rem;
    }
    .accent-block.gold .accent-label { color: var(--gold); }
    .accent-block.green .accent-label { color: var(--success); }
    .accent-block.warn .accent-label { color: var(--warn); }
    .accent-block.blue .accent-label { color: var(--info); }
    .accent-block.danger .accent-label { color: var(--danger); }
    .accent-block p { font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.65; }

    /* ── CRIMSON QUOTE ── */
    .iso-quote {
      font-family: var(--font-quote);
      font-style: italic;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--text);
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
      background: var(--gold-faded-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-gold);
      border-radius: 6px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .iso-quote cite {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-style: normal;
      font-size: .65rem;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-top: .65rem;
    }

    /* ── CLASSIFICATION BANNER ── */
    .classification-banner {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .68rem;
      letter-spacing: .18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--gold);
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .6rem;
    }

    /* ── BACK LINK ── */
    .back-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .5rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .68rem;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      transition: color .2s;
    }
    .back-link:hover { color: var(--gold); }

    /* ── FOOTER ── */
    .page-footer {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 2.5rem 0;
    }
    .footer-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 2rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .footer-meta {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .68rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      line-height: 1.9;
    }
    .footer-meta span { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .footer-back {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .5rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .68rem;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: .5rem .8rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 4px;
      transition: all .2s;
    }
    .footer-back:hover { color: var(--gold); border-color: var(--border-gold); }

    /* ── SCROLL TOP ── */
    .scroll-top {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 1.75rem;
      right: 1.75rem;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: opacity .25s, visibility .25s, border-color .2s, color .2s;
      font-size: .75rem;
      z-index: 50;
    }
    .scroll-top.visible { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
    .scroll-top:hover { border-color: var(--border-gold); color: var(--gold); }

    /* ── COHERENCE DIAGRAM ── */
    .coherence-diagram {
      display: flex;
      align-items: stretch;
      gap: 0;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .coh-cell {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 1.25rem 1rem;
      text-align: center;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: .5rem;
    }
    .coh-cell.positive { background: rgba(63,185,80,.07); border-right: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .coh-cell.negative { background: rgba(248,81,73,.05); border-right: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .coh-cell.center { background: var(--surface); border-right: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .coh-cell.neutral { background: var(--surface-2); }
    .coh-icon { font-size: 1.5rem; }
    .coh-math {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .82rem;
      color: var(--gold);
    }
    .coh-label {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .72rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .coh-label.green { color: var(--success); }
    .coh-label.red { color: var(--danger); }
    .coh-label.gold { color: var(--gold); }
    .coh-label.muted { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .coh-desc { font-size: .72rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.45; max-width: 120px; }

    /* ── SWAP TEST BOX ── */
    .swap-test-block {
      background: var(--surface-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-top: 2px solid var(--warn);
      border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px;
      padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .swap-test-label {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .65rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: .2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--warn);
      margin-bottom: .75rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .5rem;
    }
    .swap-result {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .4rem;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .72rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: .25rem .65rem;
      border-radius: 3px;
      border: 1px solid;
      margin-bottom: .85rem;
    }
    .swap-result.partial {
      color: var(--warn);
      border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.3);
      background: rgba(245,158,11,.07);
    }

    /* ── EVIDENCE ITEM ── */
    .evidence-item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      padding: 1.25rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      align-items: start;
    }
    .evidence-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .evidence-num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .65rem;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      min-width: 28px;
      text-align: right;
      padding-top: .15rem;
    }
    .evidence-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: .05em;
      color: #e6edf3;
      margin-bottom: .3rem;
    }
    .evidence-text { font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.65; }

    /* ── SCALE INDICATOR ── */
    .scale-indicator {
      display: flex;
      gap: .5rem;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .scale-label {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .62rem;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin-right: .25rem;
    }
    .scale-item {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .65rem;
      padding: .2rem .55rem;
      border-radius: 2px;
      border: 1px solid;
    }
    .scale-item.bad { color: var(--danger); border-color: rgba(248,81,73,.25); background: rgba(248,81,73,.05); }
    .scale-item.warn { color: var(--warn); border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.25); background: rgba(245,158,11,.05); }
    .scale-item.ok { color: var(--success); border-color: rgba(63,185,80,.25); background: rgba(63,185,80,.05); }

    /* ── CONNECTION CARDS ── */
    .connection-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 1.25rem;
      transition: border-color .2s;
      display: flex;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }
    .connection-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-gold); }
    .connection-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-gold);
      border-radius: 4px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: .82rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .connection-id {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: .62rem;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      margin-bottom: .2rem;
    }
    .connection-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: .88rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #e6edf3;
      letter-spacing: .04em;
      margin-bottom: .3rem;
    }
    .connection-desc { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.55; }

    /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
    @media(max-width: 768px) {

<style>
:root {
  --bg: #050505;
  --bg-elevated: #0a0a0a;
  --ink: #f0e6d3;
  --ink-dim: #b8a88a;
  --ink-faint: #6b5d4d;
  --gold: #d4af37;
  --gold-bright: #f0c659;
  --gold-dim: #8a7a3a;
  --ember: #c9461a;
  --ember-bright: #f06121;
  --accent-blue: #5a8ab8;
  --border: rgba(212,175,55,0.12);
  --border-strong: rgba(212,175,55,0.25);
  --glow-gold: rgba(212,175,55,0.15);
  --font-display: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif;
  --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
  --font-sans: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html, body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* Standalone story page: keep global reader shells off this experience. */
.site-shell-top,
.ftp-topbar,
.mtl-reader-bar {
  display: none !important;
}

body::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 10%, rgba(212,175,55,0.04) 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 80%, rgba(201,70,26,0.03) 0%, transparent 45%);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.container {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 4rem 1.5rem 6rem;
}

/* HERO */
.hero {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.hero-pretitle {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.4em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ember);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.hero-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.05;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.hero-title em {
  color: var(--gold-bright);

}

.hero-subtitle {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px);
  color: var(--ink-dim);
  max-width: 50ch;
  margin: 0 auto 32px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.story-guide {
  position: relative;
  margin: -1rem auto 2.4rem;
  padding: 1.15rem 1.25rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(212,175,55,0.2), rgba(212,175,55,0.08) 58%, rgba(201,70,26,0.05)), var(--bg-elevated);
  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.36);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.28), 0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,55,0.05);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--ink-dim);
  line-height: 1.6;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.story-guide::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--gold), transparent);
}

.story-guide strong {
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.story-guide-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 14px;
}

.story-guide-actions a {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold);
  text-decoration: none;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.18);

.story-guide-actions a:hover {

/* AUDIO PLAYER */
.audio-player {

  color: var(--gold);

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 18px;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.audio-btn:hover {
  background: var(--gold);
  color: var(--bg);

.audio-info {
  flex: 1;
  text-align: left;
}

.audio-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold-dim);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.audio-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.audio-progress {
  width: 100%;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--border);
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.audio-progress-bar {
  height: 100%;
  width: 0%;
  background: var(--gold);
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: width 0.1s linear;
}
